fields.title: Abakazi Abaanyeenya Eggulu
fields.description: Wali weebuuzizza engeri abakazi gye baakyusaamu ebyafaayo by’ensi nga bali mu bisenge ebisirifu ne ku ntebe ezaatobanga amaziga? Ekitabo kino kibikkula ekyama kyabwe: amaanyi g’okusaba okutakoowa. Okuva ku kwegayirira kwa Monika okwamala emyaka kkumi n’omusanvu okutuuka ku kukkiriza kwa Corrie ten Boom mu nkambi y’abasibe, laba engeri abalwanyi bano gye baakuumanga eggulu nga liggule.

qa.question: Ekitabo “Abakazi Abaanyeenya Eggulu” kyogera ku ki?
qa.answer: Kiraga engeri abakazi gye baakyusaamu ebyafaayo by’ensi nga bali mu bisenge ebisirifu ne ku ntebe ezaatobanga amaziga, nga bayita mu maanyi g’okusaba okutakoowa. Okuva ku kwegayirira kwa Monika okwamala emyaka kkumi n’omusanvu ku lwa mutabani we Agusito okutuuka ku kukkiriza kwa Corrie ten Boom mu nkambi y’abasibe, ekitabo kikung’aanya obulamu bw’abakazi abaakuuma eggulu nga liggule olw’okusaba kwabwe, era kiyita omusomi mu kwegayirira okwo kwennyini okw’ekyama okukyusa ensi.

qa.question: Obubaka obukulu obw’ekitabo kino bwe buliwa?
qa.answer: Nti abakazi baabumba ebyafaayo by’ensi si nga bayita ku ntebe z’obwakabaka oba ku bituuti, wabula okuva mu kifo eky’ekyama eky’okusaba — nti okwegayirira okutakoowa era okw’okukkiriza maanyi ga ddala agakyusizza obulamu bw’abantu n’amawanga. Ekitabo kiraga abakazi bano ng’obujulizi nti tewali muntu akwekebwa ennyo oba owa bulijjo ennyo atasobola kunyeenya mukono gwa Katonda ng’ayita mu kusaba.

qa.question: Monika alabikira atya mu kitabo kino?
qa.answer: Ng’ekimu ku byokulabirako byakyo ebikulu eby’okusaba okugumiikiriza. Monika yasabira okukyuka kwa mutabani we eyali awabye okumala emyaka kkumi n’omusanvu nga tannafuuka Agusito ow’e Hippo, omu ku bayigiriza b’Ekkanisa abasinga obukulu. Ekitabo kikozesa okwegayirira kwe okwamala ebbanga eddene, okw’amaziga, ng’ekyokulabirako ky’obugumiikiriza obugaana okulekulira emmeeme, era okwaddibwamu ku nkomerero.

qa.question: Corrie ten Boom alabikira atya?
qa.answer: Ng’omujulirwa w’okukkiriza n’okusaba mu mbeera ezisingira ddala okuba enzibu. Bwe yamala okukweka Abayudaaya okuva ku Banazi, ten Boom yawonawo mu nkambi y’abasibe muganda we gye yafiira, n’avaayo okubuulira okusonyiwa n’obwesigwa bwa Katonda mu nsi yonna. Ekitabo kiraga okusaba kwe n’okwesiga kwe wakati mu kubonaabona ng’obujulizi nti okwegayirira n’okukkiriza binywera ne mu nkambi ey’okuttirwamu abantu.

qa.question: Ekitabo kino kyawandiikirwa ani?
qa.answer: Buli Mukristaayo — naddala buli mukazi — awulira nga akwekeddwa oba nga talina maanyi, era eyeebuuza oba okusaba kwe kulina omugaso. Nga kiraga abakazi abaakyusa ebyafaayo nga bali mu bifo ebisirifu era ebitamanyiddwa, ekitabo kikakasa omusomi nti okusaba okutakoowa mulimu gwa ddala era ogw’amaanyi, oguggulirwawo buli ayagala okukuuma eggulu nga liggule ng’ayita mu kwegayirira.

qa.question: Ekitabo kigamba nti ekyama ky’abakazi bano kyali ki?
qa.answer: Amaanyi g’okusaba okutakoowa. Okuva mu bisenge ebisirifu ne ku ntebe ezaatobanga amaziga, nga tebalina buyinza bwa lwatu, abakazi bano baasaba ne batalekulira — era okuyita mu kwegayirira okwo baabumba engeri ebintu gye byagenda. Ekyokuyiga ekiddibwamu mu kitabo kye kino: amaanyi gaabwe tegaali mu kifo kye baalimu, wabula mu kusaba okwagaana okulekulira.

qa.question: Kikwatagana kitya ne “Abasajja Abaanyeenya Eggulu”?
qa.answer: Kye kitabo ekikigoberera, nga kikozesa endowooza y’emu ku bulamu bw’abakazi. Ng’ate “Abasajja Abaanyeenya Eggulu” bwe kikung’aanya abasajja abaasaba, ekitabo kino kikung’aanya abakazi abaasaba — Monika, Corrie ten Boom n’abalala — nga byombi biraga nti Katonda abumba ebyafaayo ng’ayita mu kwegayirira okw’ekyama okw’abantu abeetoowaze, abakazi nga bwe kiri ddala ku basajja.

qa.question: Omusomi atandikira wa?
qa.answer: Ku ntandikwa, oba ku bulamu bwonna obumusikiriza, kubanga buli bumu buyimirira bwokka — naye ekitabo kigendereddwamu okuzimba okukkiriza okutuuka ku kuyita omusomi okusaba. Bwe bisomebwa mu kusaba, ebyokulabirako bya Monika, Corrie ten Boom n’abalala bigendereddwamu okuweereza omusomi, ne bw’aba akwekeddwa atya, mu kifo eky’ekyama eky’okwegayirira okukyusa ensi.

fields.title: Ennyanjula: Abakazi Abaakuuma Eggulu Nga Liggule
fields.body_html:
Waliwo omuguwa ogudduka mu byafaayo byonna eby’Ekkanisa, era kyangu okugubuusa amaaso mu biwandiiko ebitongole. Tegukwatagana na nkiiko na nkuŋŋaana za basumba, wadde n’empaka ez’enjigiriza oba ebiwandiiko by’ebibiina. Gukwatagana n’ebisenge ebisirifu, n’okufukamira nga bukyali tebunnakya, n’okusaba okujjudde amaziga okwasabirwa abaana abeebase, bannaggwanga ababonaabona, n’embeera ezisinga okuba enzikiza ensi ze yali esobola okuleeta. Gukwatagana n’abakazi. Emirundi n’emirundi mu byasa amakumi abiri, Katonda azzeemu okusaba kw’abakazi abaalina okukkiriza okw’amaanyi ennyo, newakubadde nga kwali tekulabibwa nnyo bibiina by’abantu; okwegayiririra abalala kwabwe kwalina amaanyi mangi, newakubadde nga tekwawandiikibwa nnyo mu bitabo by’ebyafaayo.

Ebyawandiikibwa tebibuusabuusa ku nsonga eno. Nnabbi Yoweeri yalangirira Katonda yennyini kye yali asuubizza ku nnaku ez’enkomerero: “Batabani bammwe ne bawala bammwe balitegeeza eby’omu maaso; abakadde baliroota ebirooto, n’abavubuka bammwe balyolesebwa. Mu biro ebyo ndifuka Omwoyo wange ku baweereza bange abasajja n’abakazi” (Yoweeri 2:28–29). Omwoyo wa Katonda tasosola mu kikula kya muntu bw’agaba amaanyi n’okuyitibwa. Abakazi abali mu kitabo kino baakkiriza ekisuubizo ekyo nga bwe kiri ddala, ne bakituukiriza mu bulamu bwabwe n’obuziba n’obutakyukakyuka ebyakankanya ensi ebyabeetooloola.

Olukuŋŋaana lw’okusaba olwasooka okuwandiikibwa oluvannyuma lwa Kristo okulinnya mu ggulu lwalimu abakazi wakati ddala mu lwo.

Lukka annyonnyola abayigirizwa nga bakuŋŋaanye: “Abo bonna ne beeweerayo ddala n’omutima gumu okusaba wamu n’abakazi ne Maliyamu nnyina Yesu ne baganda ba Yesu” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 1:14). Era mu Ebikolwa by’Abatume 16, Pawulo ne Siira bwe baatuuka e Firipi ne banoonya ekifo eky’okusabiramu ku Ssabbiiti, baasanga ekibiina ky’abakazi nga bali dda mu kwegayiririra abalala: “… gye baali batutegeezezza nti waliwo abakuŋŋaanirayo okusabirayo. Ne tutuula wamu n’abakazi abaali bazze okusaba ne twogera nabo” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 16:13). Omuntu eyasooka okukkiriza mu Bulaaya yali Ludiya — omukazi eyasangibwa ng’asaba. Okuva mu ssaawa ezaasooka ez’Ekkanisa, abakazi babadde musingi gwa bulamu bwayo obw’okusaba.

Omukazi omulwanyi mu kusaba y’ani? Tekiri nti ateekwa okuba omukazi amanyiddwa ennyo mu bantu oba alina obuyinza mu Kkanisa. Ayinza okuba, nga Monika ow’e Hippo, maama eyagumiikiriza okumala emyaka kkumi n’omusanvu ng’asaba nga tafuna kuddibwamu, nga talina kya kulaga ku kwegayiririra abalala kwe wabula omwana omulenzi eyali yabula n’obwesige obutanyeenyezeka mu bwesigwa bwa Katonda. Ayinza okuba, nga Corrie ten Boom, omusibe mu nkambi y’Abanazi ey’okubonyaabonya eyakuuma olukuŋŋaana lw’okusaba mu kisulo kyabwe, ensi bwe yali ng’eyeyongera okugwa mu bikolobero eby’entiisa.

Ayinza okuba, nga Lottie Moon, omukazi eyagabanga emmere ye okutuusa lwe yanafuwa n’atasobola kuyimirira, n’amalira omukka gwe ogwasembayo ku nsi mu kusabira abantu be yali azze okwagala. Ayinza okuba ng’amanyiddwa Katonda yekka n’abantu abatono b’akyusa obulamu bwabwe okuyita mu kwegayiririra abalala kwe baali batategeerera ddala nti kwaliwo.

Ekigatta abakazi bano ekkumi kye kyekyo ddala Yesu kye yasuubiza bonna abandikikkirizza: okutuuka eri Kitaffe okuyita mu Mwana, embeera yonna, ekibiina kyonna, wadde amaanyi g’omuntu gonna bye bitayinza kuggyawo. Yesu yalangirira nti Kitaffe alibawa kyonna kye banaasabanga mu linnya lye: “… mmwe bennyini munaasabanga Kitange mu linnya lyange. Kino mubadde temukikola, naye kaakano mukitandike. Musabe mu linnya lyange, mujja kuweebwa ekyo kye musaba, essanyu lyammwe liryoke lituukirire” (Yokaana 16:23–24). Abakazi bano baakkiriza ekisuubizo ekyo n’amaanyi gonna ag’obulamu bwabwe. Tebaakikkiriza mu birowoozo byokka. Baakiteekako buli kimu — ebiseera byabwe eby’omu maaso, amaka gaabwe, erinnya lyabwe, obulamu bwabwe, era abamu ku bo n’eddembe lyabwe.

Abakazi bano ekkumi baava mu nsi ez’enjawulo ennyo. Monika yasabira mu Bukiikakkono bwa Afirika obwali wansi w’Abaruumi mu kyasa eky’okuna. Teresa ow’e Ávila yazza buggya ekibiina ky’Abakarumeri mu Sipeyini mu kyasa ekye kkumi n’omukaaga. Susanna Wesley yasabanga ng’abisse ekyepuloni kye ku mutwe, mu nnyumba y’omusumba ey’e Lincolnshire eyali ejjudde abantu mu kyasa ekye kkumi n’omunaana. Madame Guyon yasibibwa emyaka musanvu mu kkomera lya Bastille olw’okwewaayo kwe okw’amaanyi mu kusaba. Amy Carmichael yakolera mu Buyindi obw’Ebukiikaddyo okumala emyaka ataano mu etaano egy’omuddiring’anwa nga tawummuddeko kudda waka. Corrie ten Boom yava mu nkambi y’okubonyaabonya ey’e Ravensbrück n’agenda okubuulira okusonyiwa mu ssemazinga mukaaga. Lottie Moon yeewaayo yonna mu byalo by’e Bucayina okutuusa lwe yali nga takyalina kya kugaba. Mary Slessor yayolekagana n’abatemi b’emitwe mu Nayijeerya nga yeesigama ku kwagala n’okusaba byokka. Gladys Aylward yakulembera abaana kikumi okuyita mu nsozi ezibikkiddwa omuzira mu Bucayina mu kiseera ky’olutalo, nga tewali muntu mulala eyakkiriza okukikola. Evelyn Christenson yazimba ekibiina ky’okusaba eky’ensi yonna ku kibuuzo kimu ekikulu. Ekyabagatta tekyali kyasa kyabwe, wadde obuwangwa bwabwe oba empisa zaabwe, wabula okukakasa kwabwe okujjuvu era okutanyeenyezeka nti okusaba tekwali kintu kya ku mabbali mu bulamu bw’Omukristaayo — kwe kwali omutima gwabwo.

Ekiragiro Pawulo kye yawa Abakkolosaayi kitukwatako mu bwangu bwe bumu nga bwe kyali gye bali: “Munyiikirirenga mu kusaba, nga temuddirira, wabula nga mwebazanga” (Abakkolosaayi 4:2). Ekigambo ekivvunuddwa “munyiikirirenga” mu Luyonaani kiri proskartereo — okugumiikiriza, okwesiba ku kintu, okubeera mu kintu obutayosa. Luno si lulimi lwa ddiini ya kibogwe, wabula lwa kwewaayo okw’amaanyi okw’olunaku n’olunaku. Abakazi bano ekkumi baali beewaddeyo eri okusaba. Okusaba tekwali kintu kye baakolanga obukozi; kwali kye baali bo bennyini. Era okuyita mu bo, Katonda yakola ebintu ebikyawulikika okuyita mu byasa.

Essuula zino si bifaananyi bya byafaayo byokka. Bubaka obukuyita. Bw’onoozisoma, ojja kwesanga ng’oyimiridde emirundi mingi ku mugo gw’obulamu obw’omunda ennyo — obulamu mwe okusaba kutali buvunaanyizibwa bwa ddiini obw’okutuukiriza obutuukiriza, wabula enkolagana ennamu gy’obeeramu. Obulamu obwo bukusobokera. Buli muntu anoonya Katonda n’omutima gwe gwonna amulaba. Ekyo si kigambo kya kuzzaamu bantu maanyi bwereere; kye kisuubizo kya Katonda, ekigezeseddwa mu bulamu bw’abantu nkumi kkumi, era ne kikakasibwa nate mu bakazi bano ekkumi ab’ekitalo.

Obulamu bwabwe bukuleetere obutamatira obutukuvu n’okukkiriza okw’oku ngulu. Bukuleetere obutawummula olw’eddiini ennafu, ey’ekyanguyirize, era ey’omukolo obukozi. Bukusindike ku maviivi go n’enjala empya n’okusuubira okuzzibwa obuggya — era osangeyo Katonda y’omu ataggwaawo abakazi bano gwe baasanga ng’abalindiridde.

fields.title: Monika ow’e Hippo — Maama Amaziga Ge Gaanyeenya Eggulu
fields.body_html:
Yali Ani

Monika yazaalibwa mu mwaka 331 AD e Tagaste, mu Afirika ey’Obukiikakkono eyali wansi w’obufuzi bwa Ruumi — ekitundu ekiyitibwa leero Algeria — mu maka g’Abakristaayo, okukkiriza kwabwe okw’amaanyi ne kumuyingira okuva mu buto. Omusingi gw’Ebyawandiikibwa ogw’okwegayiririra kwa Monika tegwali lunyiriri lumu, wabula empisa ya Katonda yonna nga Kitaffe awulira okukaaba kw’abaana be. Olugero lwa Yesu olwa nnamwandu ateekoowa teyalutwala ng’ekifaananyi — lwali kuyitibwa kwe. Engeri gye yasabangamu yatuukiriza ekiragiro ekyo: nti abantu “bagwanidde obutakoowanga kusaba n’obutaggwaamu mwoyo” (Lukka 18:1). Emyaka kkumi n’omusanvu bbanga ddene okusabira emmeeme y’omuntu omu. Buli kipya ekyabangawo kyali kugezesa kupya eri okukkiriza kwe, era buli mulundi yaddanga ku maviivi ge n’okusaba kwe kumu, n’amaziga ge gamu, n’okusuubira kwe kumu okutakendeera.

Ambrose, Omulabirizi w’e Milan, eyali agenda okuba ekyuma Katonda kye yakozesa okukyusa Agusito, yalaba mu Monika ekintu ekitali kya bulijjo. Obulamu bwe obw’okusaba tebwali kutuukiriza buvunaanyizibwa bwa ddiini, wabula kufukumuka kw’omutima ogwewaayo ddala eri Katonda n’eri omwana Katonda gwe yali amuwadde. Ekifaananyi ky’Omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli kyali mazima mu bulamu bwe: “Emirundi gye ntawaanyizibwa nga njaziirana ogimanyi; amaziga gange gateeke mu ccupa yo! Wagawandiika” (Zabbuli 56:8). Monika kino yakikkiriza si ng’ebigambo eby’ennyimba, wabula ng’amazima gennyini. Buli zziga lye yakaabira Agusito lyali kusaba Katonda kwe yali awulidde era n’akuwandiika. Tewali na limu lyagenda bwereere. Byonna byali bikuŋŋaanyizibwa nga bigenda eri okuddibwamu.

Okwegayiririra abalala kwe okutakoowa kwalaga enjigiriza ey’amaanyi ku kusaasira kwa Katonda eri abaabula. Ebigambo bya Pawulo mu 1 Timoseewo byalaga bulungi omugugu gwe: “Okusookera ddala, mbasaba, musabenga, mwegayirirenga, era mwebazenga Katonda ku lw’abantu bonna. Era musabirenga bakabaka n’abafuzi abalala bonna, tulyoke tube bulungi nga tuli mirembe, nga tussaamu Katonda ekitiibwa, era nga twegendereza mu buli ngeri. Ekyo kirungi era ekisiimibwa mu maaso ga Katonda Omulokozi waffe, ayagala abantu bonna balokolebwe, era bategeere amazima” (1 Timoseewo 2:1–4). Monika yategeera nti okusabira abaabula si kintu kya kwongerako ku bulamu bw’Omukristaayo, wabula buvunaanyizibwa obukulu — obusibuka mu mutima gwa Katonda ayagala ddala buli muntu alokolebwe.

Agusito yennyini yawandiika n’okwewuunya ku bulamu bw’okusaba bwa nnyina mu kitabo kye eky’Okwatula, ng’annyonnyola engeri okukaaba kwe mu maaso ga Katonda ku lulwe bwe kwali okw’amaanyi okusinga okukaaba kwa bamaama abasinga obungi nga baana baabwe bafudde mu mubiri. Yali ategeera obuzito bw’ensonga. Emmeeme eyali mu kkubo erigenda mu ggeyeena yali nsonga ya bwangu okusinga akabi konna ak’ensi eno. Ekitabo ky’Okukungubaga kyalaga bulungi omwoyo gwe: “Golokoka, okaabe ekiro obudde nga bwa kaziba; Fuka emmeeme yo ng’amazzi mu maaso ga Mukama” (Okukungubaga 2:19). Monika yeefuka yenna — ddala, nga tayimirira — era Katonda yafuna buli ttondo.

Okukakasibwa kw’okwegayiririra kwa Monika okwamala ebbanga eddene tekwali kukyuka kwa musajja omu omugezi ennyo kwokka, newankubadde ekyo kyokka kyandibadde kimala okulaga nti obulamu bwonna obw’okusaba bwali bwa mugaso. Kyali kukyuka kwa mbeera okugumiikiriza kwe kwe kwalaga nti kusoboka: obukakafu nti tewali mutima mukakanyavu, obulamu obwabula ennyo, wadde ekibi ekisimbye amakanda, ebisukka amaanyi ga Katonda addamu okusaba. Ekisuubizo ky’Omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli kyakakasibwa mu bulamu bwe: “Abo abasiga nga bakaaba amaziga, baliyimba ennyimba ez’essanyu nga bakungula. Oyo agenda ng’akaaba ng’atwala ensigo okusiga; alikomawo ng’ayimba ennyimba ez’essanyu ng’aleeta ebinywa bye” (Zabbuli 126:5–6). Monika yasiga mu maziga okumala emyaka kkumi n’omusanvu.

Amakungula ge yakungula — okukyuka kw’omusajja ebiwandiiko bye byali bigenda okubumba enjigiriza y’Ekikristaayo okumala ebyasa kkumi na bitaano — gaali gasukkiridde nnyo okusinga byonna bye yali ayinza okusaba ne bye yali ayinza okulowooza.

Okusaba

Ayi Mukama Katonda, oli Kitaffe atakoowa kutuwulira. Tuyigirize obukakanyavu obutukuvu bwa Monika — okuleeta emmeeme y’emu, omugugu gwe gumu, n’ekyetaago kye kimu mu maaso go buli lunaku, buli mwaka, okutuusa okuddamu kwo lwe kunaatuuka. Gye tukemebwa okuggwaamu amaanyi, zzaawo okukkiriza kwaffe. Gye tukaabira abaabula, tujjukize nti buli zziga olikuuma. Era tukkirize tubeere balamu okulaba amakungula okusaba kwaffe ge kusimba. Amiina.

fields.title: Teresa ow’e Ávila — Omukazi ow’Okufumiitiriza Eyazimba Essomero ly’Okusaba
fields.body_html:
Yali Ani

Teresa ow’e Ávila yazaalibwa nga 28 Ogwokusatu 1515, mu kibuga Ávila mu Castile, mu Sipeyini, mu maka ag’obugagga agaali ag’ensibuko y’Abayudaaya abaakyuka ne bafuuka Abakristaayo. Yayingira ennyumba y’ababiikira ab’ekibiina kya Kalumeeri eyitibwa Incarnation ng’aweza emyaka abiri, n’amala emyaka kumpi abiri ng’obulamu bwe obw’omwoyo bwa wakati na wakati, okutuusa ku myaka asatu mu mwenda lwe yasisinkana Katonda mu ngeri ey’amaanyi, ekyakyusa obulamu bwe obw’okusaba emirembe gyonna. Yafuuka omu ku bakazi abasinga okwewuunyisa mu byafaayo by’Ekkanisa abaali bawaayo obulamu bwabwe eri okufumiitiriza n’okusisinkana Katonda mu kasirise; yazza obuggya mu kibiina kya Kalumeeri, n’atandikawo ennyumba z’ababiikira kkumi na musanvu — byonna ng’alwadde nnyo mu mubiri era ng’awakanyizibwa nnyo abakulembeze b’Ekkanisa. Ebitabo bye ebikulu — Ekigo eky’Omunda, Ekkubo ery’Okutuukirira, n’ekitabo ky’obulamu bwe — bikyali mu biragiriro ebisinga obuziba ebyali biwandiikiddwa ku bulamu bw’okusaba, era mu 1970 yafuuka omukazi eyasooka okuweebwa ekitiibwa ky’Omuyigiriza w’Ekkanisa mu Kkanisa Katoliki ey’e Rooma.

Kye Yayigiriza ku Kusaba

Ekyo Teresa kye yali akkiririzaamu ennyo kyali nti okusaba okw’omu birowoozo — okwogera kw’emmeeme ne Katonda munda — si kwa bafumiitiriza ab’enjawulo bokka, ababiikira, n’abo abaakula ennyo mu mwoyo. Kyali kya buli Mukristaayo ayagala okuyingira mu kisenge eky’omunda Katonda gy’alindirira. Okusaba okw’omu birowoozo yakunnyonnyola nti si kirala wabula “okugabana okw’okumpi wakati w’emikwano; kitegeeza okwewaako ebiseera ebingi okubeera wekka n’Oyo gwe tumanyi nti atwagala.” Ennyinnyonnyola eno yaggulawo oluggi lw’okufumiitiriza eri buli muntu: teyasaba kweyagala okw’ekitalo oba okwolesebwa, wabula omukwano, obwesige, n’okwagala okubeerawo mu maaso ga Katonda.

Omusingi gw’Ebyawandiikibwa ogw’engeri Teresa gye yasabangamu kwali kuyita kwa Kristo yennyini: “Naye ggwe bw’obanga osaba, oyingiranga mu nnyumba yo, ne weggalira mu kisenge kyo n’osabira eyo mu kyama. Kitaawo ategeera ebyama byo byonna alikuwa by’omusabye” (Matayo 6:6). “Ekisenge” Yesu kye yayogerako, eri Teresa, tekyali kifo kya mubiri kyokka wabula eky’omunda — ekisenge eky’omunda ennyo mu mmeeme, Katonda gy’abeera dda, era okusaba okusinga obuziba gye kubeerera mu kasirise, ebigambo we bikoma. Yayigiriza bannyina mu Kristo nti empisa esinga obukulu mu bulamu bw’Omukristaayo kwe kwagala okuyingira mu kisenge ekyo buli lunaku n’osigala omwo, ng’ofaayo n’okwagala era ng’oli mwetegefu okufuna okuva eri Oyo alindirira munda.

Ekifaananyi kya Teresa ekimanyiddwa ennyo mu Ekigo eky’Omunda — emmeeme ng’ekigo ekya kiristaalo ekirimu ebisulo musanvu, ekisulo eky’omunda ddala nga kye kibeeramu Katonda yennyini — kwali kufumiitiriza kwe okuwanvu ku kusaba okw’okwegatta ne Katonda. Yayigiriza nti Katonda asika emmeeme mpolampola okugenda munda ng’ayita mu madaala g’okusaba agagenda geeyongera, okuva ku kusaba okw’eddoboozi, okuyita mu kufumiitiriza, okutuuka ku kutunuulira Katonda mu kasirise, okutuusa nga mu ddaala erisinga obuziba emmeeme ewummulira mu kumanya nti Katonda ali awo, ekintu ebigambo kye bitasobola kunnyonnyola. Olugendo luno terwali lwa lwokka wadde olwangu; lwetaagisa okukolagana ne Katonda obutakoowa, okwewaayo nga muntu alekayo by’ayagala ye, n’okugumiikiriza ebiseera bye yayita “ebikalu” okusaba lwe kwawuliranga nga kukalu era nga Katonda alabika ng’atali awo. Naye yali munywevu: “Ekikulu si kulowooza nnyo wabula kwagala nnyo; kale kola kyonna ekisinga okukusikiriza okwagala.”

Yali wa magezi nnyo ku mpisa eyetaagisa okunyweza obulamu bw’okusaba bwe yannyonnyola.

Emmeeme esaba oba eteesaba okusinziira ku ngeri gy’ewuliramu terigenda wala mu buziba. Yajuliziza Zabbuli 46:10 n’amaanyi ag’enjawulo — “Musiriikirire mutegeere nga nze Katonda” — ng’embeera omuntu gy’alina okubeeramu okusobola okufumiitiriza ddala. Okusirika, bwe yayigiriza, tekwali kutuula butuuzi wabula y’empisa ey’omwoyo esinga okwetaagisa amaanyi: okulekayo mu bugenderevu ebiwugula, okwefaako, n’oluyoogaano, osobole okuwuliriza Oyo bulijjo ayogera. Bannyina mu Kristo mu nnyumba z’ababiikira za Kalumeeri ezaazzibwamu obuggya baatendekebwanga mu mpisa eno okuva ku nnaku zaabwe ezaasooka, era Teresa yennyini yamalanga essaawa nnyingi buli lunaku ng’akola bw’atyo, ne bwe yabanga ng’atandikawo ennyumba z’ababiikira mmeka, ng’awandiika ebbaluwa mmeka, oba ng’abonaabona nnyo atya mu mubiri.

Endowooza ye ku kubonaabona mu kusaba y’emu ku birabo bye ebisinga obukulu. Teresa yalwalanga endwadde ezaamunafuyanga mu bulamu bwe bwonna — nga mw’otwalidde n’ekiseera ky’alabika okuba nti yali kumpi n’okufa ng’aweza emyaka asatu mu musanvu — n’ategeera nti okubonaabona si kiziyiza eri obulamu bw’okusaba wabula lye limu ku masomero gaakwo amakulu. Yafuna essanyu lingi mu kigambo kya Pawulo ekiwuniikiriza: “Buli mulundi ng’aŋŋamba nti, ‘Ekisa kyange kikumala, kubanga amaanyi gange gatuukirira mu bunafu.’

Noolwekyo kyennaavanga nneegulumiza n’essanyu lingi olw’obunafu bwange, amaanyi ga Kristo galyoke galabisibwe” (2 Abakkolinso 12:9). Obunafu obwamulemesanga okuddukanya ensonga ze ku bubwe bwe, yazuula nti bwe bwali embeera ennyini Katonda mw’asinga okutwalira mu maanyi obuvunaanyizibwa bw’okuddukanya buli kimu. Yawandiikira bannyina mu Kristo nti: “Katonda atambula wakati w’ensuwa n’ebibbo by’omu ffumbiro.”

Ebya bulijjo, ebiruma, n’ebitaliimu kitiibwa byonna byali bya kukozesa mu bulamu obw’okusaba.

Kiyinza okuba nti ekisinze okubeerera, Teresa yayigiriza nti okusaba si kwetegekera kukola, wabula kwo kwennyini kwe kukola okusinga obukulu era okubala ebibala ebingi emmeeme y’omuntu bw’esobola. Ebigambo bya Yesu eri abayigirizwa be — “…awatali Nze temuliiko kye muyinza kukola” (Yokaana 15:5) — eri Teresa tebyali kunenya wabula kusumululwa: kulangirira nti emmeeme ebeera mu Katonda teyetaaga kwewaliriza na kweyanguyiriza kutuuka ku bibala. fields.title: Susanna Wesley — Nnyina w’Abametodisti
fields.body_html:
Yali Ani

Susanna Annesley Wesley yazaalibwa nga 20 Gatonnya 1669, mu London, ng’ye mwana ow’amakumi abiri mu ataano owa kitaawe, omusumba omututumufu ow’Abanonkonfomisti (abaali beeyawudde ku Kkanisa ya Bungereza), eyalina etterekero ly’ebitabo by’eby’eddiini n’amaka agaali mu nteeko, ebyabumba amagezi ge n’obulamu bwe obw’omwoyo okuva mu buwere. Yafumbirwa Samuel Wesley mu 1688, ne basenga e Epworth mu Lincolnshire, gye yazaalira abaana kkumi na mwenda, mwenda ku bo ne bakula ne batuuka mu bukulu. Babiri ku batabani be — John ne Charles Wesley — baali ba kutandikawo ekibiina ky’Abametodisti era ne bafuuka ku Bakristaayo abaasinga okuba n’obuyinza mu kyasa ekya kkumi na munaana, naye Susanna ye yali omusomesa waabwe eyasooka era eyasinga okubabumba. Wadde nga yali mu kunyigirizibwa kumpi okutayinza kulowoozekako okw’okuddukanya amaka amanene mu bwavu, yeewaayo okumala waakiri essaawa bbiri buli lunaku yekka ne Katonda mu kusaba, n’okuwa buli mwana essaawa emu buli wiiki ey’okumuyigiriza ebya Katonda ng’ali yekka. Yafa mu 1742 ng’alina emyaka nsanvu mu esatu, era John yawandiika nti yafa “mu ngeri esaanira obulamu bwe.”

Okuyigiriza Kwe Okukulu ku Kusaba

Okuyigiriza kwa Susanna Wesley ku kusaba tekwayinza kwawulwa ku ngeri gye yali ategeeramu amaka ng’ekifo ekikulu eky’okukuza abantu mu by’omwoyo. Yakkiriza nti okusaba okusinga okuba n’ebiva ebinene mu nsi emirundi mingi kwe kwo okusabibwa mu bifo by’awaka ebya bulijjo — ku mmeeza z’omu ffumbiro, ku mabbali g’obuliri bw’abaana, ne mu nkola ey’ettutumu gye yamanyikiramu: okutuula ng’asika epuloni ye n’agibikka ku mutwe wakati mu maka ge, ng’akabonero eri abaana be nti ali mu kusaba era tebalina kumutawaanya. Mu mbeera eyo ey’awaka, yasisinkana Katonda akyusa emirembe n’emirembe.

Susanna yali ategeera omulimu gwe nga maama, si nga mulabirizi wa maka okusingira ddala, wabula ng’omusumba ow’omwoyo ng’okusaba kwe gwe musingi ogutalabika ogw’ebiseera by’amaka ge eby’omu maaso. Yassa nnyo omwoyo ku musingi ogw’edda: “Manyiiriza omwana mu kkubo erimugwanira okutambulirangamu, ne bw’alikula talirivaamu.” (Engero 22:6). Kino tekyali kya kukuza baana kyokka gy’ali, wabula kyali njigiriza ya kwegayiririra abalala: okukkiriza nti okusaba kw’omuzadde, okuweebwayo obutayosa era n’omwoyo gwonna ku lw’omwana okuva mu myaka gye egisooka, kubumba enkula y’obulamu bw’omwana oyo obw’omwoyo mu ngeri nti tewali kintu kirala kijja oluvannyuma kiyinza kukiggyawo ddala. Yasabiranga abaana be ng’abayita amannya gaabwe, n’ebisabibwa ebitegeerekeka, era ng’asuubira Katonda okuddamu.

Empisa ye ey’obunyiikivu yali ya kitalo mu ngeri yonna gy’oyinza okugipima. Essaawa bbiri ez’okusaba buli lunaku mu maka agaalimu abaana abalamu abatuuka ku kkumi, ensimbi entono, n’omwami eyabanga taliiwo emirundi mingi, tebyali bibala bya mbeera nnyangu, wabula bya kukakasa okugumu ng’ekyuma. Kirabika yatwala ebigambo by’omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli ng’endagaano ye ku bubwe: “Ngolokoka bunatera okukya ne nkukaabirira onnyambe; essuubi lyange liri mu kigambo kyo.” (Zabbuli 119:147). Okusaba eri Susanna tekwali kwa kunyigirizibwa mu mabanga g’obulamu obujjudde emirimu, wabula gwe gwali omusingi ebirala byonna kwe byategekebwa. Yawandiika mu bbaluwa nti: “Wadde ebitone byange byali bitono, sirina kye nnayinza kuddiza Katonda olw’okwagala kwe okungi okuggyako okumuddizaawo ebitone ebyo — era ekisinga obunene ku byo kye nnina bye biseera.”

Ennyumba y’omusumba e Epworth bwe yaggya omuliro mu 1709, John ow’emyaka omukaaga n’awonyezebwa mu nnimi z’omuliro mu ngeri ey’ekyewuunyo ku kaseera akasembayo, Susanna yakitwala ng’akabonero okuva eri Katonda. Yawandiika mu kitabo kye mwe yawandiikanga ebirowoozo bye nti okuva ku lunaku olwo yali wa kussa omwoyo ogw’enjawulo ku mwoyo gwa John, ng’ayongera nnyo okusaba kwe n’okuyigiriza kwe, ng’akakasa nti Katonda yali amuwonyezza olw’ekigendererwa. Okukakasa kuno kwennyini kwali ngeri ya kusaba — ekikolwa eky’okwesiga ebigendererwa bya Katonda afuga byonna: “Kubanga mmanyi enteekateeka ze nnina gye muli,” bw’ayogera Mukama, “enteekateeka ez’okubakulaakulanya so si okubakolako akabi, enteekateeka ez’okubawa essuubi era n’obulamu obw’omu maaso” (Yeremiya 29:11). Yasaba enteekateeka ezo zituukirire nga tannaba na kuzimanya nti zaali ki.

Susanna era yalina enjigiriza ennywevu ku kusaba kw’ekibiina n’amaanyi gaakwo okubumba abantu awamu. Nga John Wesley tannaba kuteekawo mu ngeri entongole nkuŋŋaana za bibiina ebitono, Susanna yali akuŋŋaanya abantu mu nnyumba ye awatali kuteekateeka okusaba n’okuyigiriza — enkuŋŋaana ezaasikiriza abantu abasoba mu bikumi bibiri mu kiseera kye zaasinga okwettanirwa, era ezaaleeta obukuubagano obw’amaanyi n’omwami we, ataali mumativu n’obukulembeze bwe. Enkuŋŋaana zino yazisimba ku kisuubizo kya Kristo: “Kubanga abantu ababiri oba abasatu bwe banaakuŋŋaananga mu linnya lyange, nange nnaabeeranga awo wakati waabwe.” (Matayo 18:20). Bwe kiba nti babiri oba basatu baali bamala okufuna okubeerawo kwa Kristo, bwe yalowooza, kale olukuŋŋaana lw’abantu ebikumi bibiri terwandisinzeewo nnyo? Enkuŋŋaana ze ez’okusaba awaka ze zaali ekifaananyi ekisooka eky’ekibiina ky’Abametodisti mutabani we kye yazimba oluvannyuma ne kibuna ensi yonna.

Mu nkomerero, omusika gwe tegwali kukyuka n’obuweereza bw’abaana be kyokka, wabula obujulizi obulamu nti obwesigwa mu kusaba okutalabika, okutaliimu kitiibwa, okwa buli lunaku, buzaala ebibala ebisukka ku ebyo omusizi by’ayinza okulowooza. Yalaga mu bulamu bwe okwatula kw’amaka ga Isirayiri: “Naye nze n’ennyumba yange, ffe tunaaweerezanga Mukama Katonda” (Yoswa 24:15) — si ng’ebigambo eby’eddiini eby’okwogera obwogezi, wabula ng’okulonda okwa buli lunaku, okwalina omuwendo gwe yasasulanga, okuddibwangamu obutayosa. Okuva mu kifo kye eky’okusabiramu awaka, eky’ebigere kkumi na munaana, okuzuukuka kwasaasaana ne kutuuka mu ggwanga lyonna, n’oluvannyuma mu nsi yonna.

Okusaba

Ayi Katonda omwesigwa, tujjukize nti ebifo ebya bulijjo ennyo tebikukwekeddwa n’akatono.

Bwe tuwulira obutono bw’embeera zaffe, gaziya okukkiriza kwaffe. Okusaba kwaffe bwe kulabika ng’okw’awaka ennyo era okukwekeddwa ennyo okuba n’amakulu, tujjukize Susanna — nti okusaba kwa maama omu eyeewaayo kuyinza okubumba ekkubo ly’emirembe n’emirembe. Tuwe empisa ey’obunyiikivu okukuwa ebiseera byaffe ebisinga obulungi, n’okukkiriza okukakasa nti tewali kintu kyonna ekiweebwayo gy’oli mu kyama ekifa obwereere. Amiina.

Yasaba enteekateeka ezo zituukirire nga tannaba na kuzimanya nti zaali ki. Susanna era yalina enjigiriza ennywevu ku kusaba kw’ekibiina n’amaanyi gaakwo okubumba abantu awamu. Nga John Wesley tannaba kuteekawo mu ngeri entongole nkuŋŋaana za bibiina ebitono, Susanna yali akuŋŋaanya abantu mu nnyumba ye awatali kuteekateeka okusaba n’okuyigiriza — enkuŋŋaana ezaasikiriza abantu abasoba mu bikumi bibiri mu kiseera kye zaasinga okwettanirwa, era ezaaleeta obukuubagano obw’amaanyi n’omwami we, ataali mumativu n’obukulembeze bwe. Okusaba Ayi Katonda omwesigwa, tujjukize nti ebifo ebya bulijjo ennyo tebikukwekeddwa n’akatono. Bwe tuwulira obutono bw’embeera zaffe, gaziya okukkiriza kwaffe. fields.title: Madame Guyon — Omusibe Ow’omwoyo Ogutayinza Kusibibwa
fields.body_html:
Yali Ani

Jeanne-Marie Bouvières de la Mothe Guyon yazaalibwa nga 13 Apuli 1648, mu Montargis, mu Bufalansa, mu maka ag’obugagga, n’afumbirwa ng’aweza emyaka kkumi n’etaano omusajja eyali amusinga ennyo emyaka, era n’addukanya amaka ge okumala emyaka kkumi n’ebiri egy’obufumbo obuzibu okutuusa omwami we lwe yafa mu 1676. Okuva mu buto bwe yalina obulamu obw’omunda obw’okusaba obw’amaanyi, era bba bwe yamala okufa, ne yeewaayo ddala eri Katonda, n’atambula mu Bufalansa ne mu Savoy ng’ayigiriza engeri y’okusaba okw’okufumiitiriza gye yayita “okusaba okw’akasirise” oba “okwagala okulongoofu.” Obuyinza bwe bwali bunene nnyo, ne busikiriza abagoberezi okuva mu bakungu b’Abafalansa ne mu bakulembeze ab’oku ntikko mu Kkanisa Enkatoliki, naye enjigiriza ze nazo ne zireeta okuziyizibwa okw’amaanyi okuva mu bakulu b’Ekkanisa. Yasibibwa mu kkomera lya Bastille okuva mu 1698 okutuuka mu 1703 — emyaka ena mu kasenge ng’ali yekka — era n’awandiika ebimu ku bitabo bye ebisinga okumasamasa ng’ali mu kasenge ke. Yateebwa mu 1703, n’amala emyaka gye egy’enkomerero mu buwaŋŋanguse obw’emirembe e Blois, ng’awandiika okutuusa lwe yafa mu 1717 ng’aweza emyaka nkaaga mu munaana.

Enjigiriza Ye Enkulu ku Kusaba

Enjigiriza ya Madame Guyon enkulu yali okusaba okwangu — engeri y’okusaba okw’omunda emmeeme mw’ekomya okufuba kwayo ku bwayo n’ewummulira mu Katonda, si lwa kwerongoosaamu birowoozo byonna, wabula lwa kukyusa okufaayo kwayo kwonna, mu kwagala, eri okubeerawo kwa Katonda okuli edda munda mu yo. Kino yakyawula ku kusaba okw’okufuba, emmeeme mw’etegana okuzaala ebigambo ebituufu, enneewulira entuufu, oba ebirowoozo ebituufu. Yayigiriza nti okusaba okulongoofu tekuzaalibwa mmeeme wabula kufunibwa — kwe kubooga okw’obwereere okw’omutima ogwayiga okuwummulira mu Katonda mu kifo ky’okufuba okumutuukako.

Ekintu ekinene Guyon kye yazuula mu bulamu bwe obw’okusaba kwe kuba nti embeera z’obulamu obw’ebweru — nga mw’otwalidde okusibibwa, okufiirwa, n’okubonaabona — tezaalina buyinza ku bulamu obw’omunda obw’emmeeme eyeewaayo ddala eri Katonda. Mu bigambo bya Pawulo yasangamu obujulirwa bwe ye: “Mu buli mbeera gye mbaamu nayiga okumalibwanga. Mmanyi okubeera nga sirina kantu, era mmanyi okuba nga nnina buli kimu” (Abafiripi 4:11–12). Ekkomera lya Bastille lyali lisobola okusiba omubiri gwe naye nga terisobola kutuuka ku mwoyo gwe. Mu kitabo ky’obulamu bwe yawandiika nti emyaka gye yamala mu kkomera gye gimu ku gisinga okubaamu essanyu mu bulamu bwe, kubanga mu kasirise ne mu kubeera yekka bye yakakibwa, yasangamu obuziba bw’okussa ekimu ne Katonda, eddembe lye yalina mu myaka gye egyasooka — eryali lijjudde emirimu — lye litaali lyabumuwa. “Emmeeme eyeewaayo ddala eri Katonda,” bwe yawandiika, “esanga olusuku lwa Katonda mu buli kkomera.”

Ekitabo kye Experiencing the Depths of Jesus Christ (Okutuuka mu Buziba bwa Yesu Kristo) — ng’agamba ye kennyini nti yakiwandiika mu nnaku ntono nnyo, ng’alinga Omwoyo Omutukuvu ye yali amusomera by’awandiika — kyayigiriza abasomi okusemberera Ebyawandiikibwa n’okusaba si na kwekenneenya kwa magezi, wabula n’okufaayo okw’okwagala okweteeseteese okukkiriza. Yageraageranya engeri eno ku kulya: ekigendererwa ky’okusoma Ebyawandiikibwa mu kusaba tekyali kukuŋŋaanya bimanyisibwa wabula okuliisibwa. Ebigambo Yesu bye yagamba abayigirizwa be byayolesa ekyo kye yali akkiriza ennyo ku musingi gw’obulamu buno obw’okusaba: “Olwo nga sikyabayita baddu, kubanga omuddu tamanya bifa ku mukama we. Kaakano mmwe muli mikwano gyange, kubanga mbategeezezza byonna Kitange bye yaŋŋamba” (Yokaana 15:15). Emmeeme esaba teyali musabi afuba okuweebwa ekkubo eri kabaka atayagala, wabula yali mukwano gwa Katonda eyayanirizibwa mu by’ekyama bye ebisingayo okuba eby’omunda. Omukwano guno gwe gwali ettaka mwe kwakulira okusaba kwonna okwa nnamaddala.

Enjigiriza ya Guyon ku kubonaabona ng’omuliro ogulongoosa okusaba yalimu obuziba obwava mu bye yayitamu ye kennyini. Obulungi bwe yabufiirwa olw’endwadde ya kawaali, eddembe lye olw’okusibibwa, erinnya lye olw’empaka, n’obuyinza bwe olw’okusalirwa omusango abakulu b’Ekkanisa — era mu buli kufiirwa yasangamu obulamu bw’okusaba obutakendeera wabula obwalongoosebwa. Yanywerera ku kisuubizo ekinene mu Isaaya: “Bw’onooyitanga mu mazzi amawanvu nnaabeeranga naawe, ne bw’onooyitanga mu migga tegirikusaanyaawo; bw’onooyitanga mu muliro tegukwokyenga, ennimi z’omuliro tezirikwokya” (Isaaya 43:2). Eri Guyon, bino tebyali bigambo bya kubudaabuda bye yali afunira wala n’okwebaza. Byali bunnyonnyozi obutuufu obw’ebyafaayo bye ye, ebyagezesebwa ne bikakasibwa mu mazzi ne mu miliro egy’obulamu bwe obwa nnamaddala.

Yakalambiranga nti okusaba okusinga obuziba kwetaaga okwerekereza ddala okusingayo. Emmeeme esemberera Katonda ng’ekyakwatiridde by’eyagala, enteekateeka zaayo, obuweerero bwayo — wadde n’ebiruubirirwa byayo eby’omwoyo — yandisanze ekkubo lyayo okutuuka mu buziba bwa Katonda nga liziyiziddwa ebintu byennyini bye yali yeetisse. Mu bigambo bya Pawulo ebyewuunyisa mu Abafiripi yasangamu emirembe egiva mu kwewaayo kuno: “N’emirembe gya Katonda, egisukkiridde okutegeera kwammwe ginaabakuumanga amagezi gammwe n’emitima gyammwe mu Kristo Yesu” (Abafiripi 4:7). Emirembe egyo egisukkiridde tegyali mirembe gya mbeera nnungi wabula emirembe gy’omutima ogwewaayo ddala — emmeeme eyali erekedde awo okuwakana ne Katonda ku nkola y’obulamu bwayo era ng’ekkirizza, n’okwagala, buli ky’agiweereza.

Omusika gwe ogw’enkomerero bwe bukakafu bwe yawa — okuyita mu bulamu bwe ye obwewuunyisa — nti tewali buyinza bwa bweru busobola ddala kusiba mmeeme eyayiga okusaba okuva munda okudda ebweru. Ekkomera eryasinga okunywezebwa mu nsi teryasobola kusirisa kusaba kwa Madame Guyon wadde okukendeeza ku ssanyu lye. Mu makulu gaakyo amajjuvu, yali wa ddembe — nga Pawulo bwe yategeeza ng’ali mu kusibibwa kwe ye: “Kale nno Mukama ye Mwoyo, era buli Omwoyo wa Mukama w’abeera, wabaawo eddembe” (2 Abakkolinso 3:17).

Buli Omwoyo wa Mukama w’abeera, buli kkomera lifuuka ekifo ekitukuvu.

Essaala

Mukama ow’eddembe lyonna, tuyigirize okusaba okutasobola kutaataaganyizibwa mbeera yonna. Embeera ez’ebweru bwe ziba enzibu, tusembeze mu kisenge eky’omunda gy’obeera bulijjo era gy’oli kumpi bulijjo. Tununule mu buddu bw’okwetaaga embeera ennungi tusobole okusaba, era mu kifo ky’ekyo tulage essanyu ly’emmeeme eyafuna amaka gaayo mu ggwe wekka. Amiina.

fields.title: Amy Carmichael — Omuminsani Eyasabanga Obutayosa
fields.body_html:
Yali Ani

Amy Beatrice Carmichael yazaalibwa nga 16 Ddesemba 1867, mu Millisle, County Down, mu Ireland, nga ye mwana omukulu mu baana musanvu ab’amaka g’Abapulesubiteeriya agaali gatya Katonda ennyo. Oluvannyuma lw’okufuna obumanyirivu obw’omwoyo obw’amaanyi mu buvubuka bwe, yeewaayo eri omulimu gw’obuminsani, n’aweereza okumala akaseera katono mu Japan ne mu Ceylon nga tannatuuka mu Buyindi obw’ebukiikaddyo mu 1895 — gye yabeera okumala emyaka ataano mu ttaano egyaddirira nga tafunye luwummula na lumu olw’okuddayo ewaabwe. Yatandikawo ekibiina kya Dohnavur Fellowship mu Tamil Nadu, mu kusooka okununula abawala abato okuva mu bwamalaaya obw’omu masabo, era ekibiina ekyo ne kikula ne kifuuka ekitundu ky’abantu abasoba mu lwenda, nga kiwa amaka abaana abaali batalina walala wa kugenda. Emyaka amakumi abiri egy’enkomerero y’obulamu bwe yagimala okusinga ng’agalamidde ku kitanda oluvannyuma lw’okugwa obubi mu 1931, n’awandiika ng’ali mu kisenge kye ebitabo ebisoba mu asatu eby’ebitontome n’eby’okwewaayo eri Katonda, ebyafuuka eby’omuwendo eby’omwoyo ebyagalwa ennyo mu nsi yonna. Yafa mu 1951 ng’aweza emyaka kinaana mu ssatu, nga tavangangako mu Buyindi kasookedde atuukayo.

Enjigiriza Ye Enkulu ku Kusaba

Obulamu bwa Amy Carmichael obw’okusaba bwe bwali omusingi ogukwekeddwa ogw’ebintu byonna ebyalabikanga e Dohnavur. Yannyonnyolanga okusaba ng’omulimu omukulu ogw’ekibiina, ogw’omusingi okusinga okuliisa abaana, okusomesa mu masomero, oba okuzimba amayumba. Buli kusalawo okukulu kwakolebwanga ku maviivi. Buli mwana eyayingizibwanga mu kitundu yasabirwanga ng’ayogerwako erinnya lye. Buli kizibu kyasookanga kusisinkanibwa mu kusaba nga tekinnasisinkanibwa mu bikolwa. Yagamba bakozi banne nti: “Okusaba gwe mutima gw’olunaku lwaffe. Ggyamu okusaba, olunaku lwandigwa, lwandibadde lwa bwereere ng’olumuli olutaliimu kintu munda.”

Endowooza ya Carmichael ey’omusingi yali nti obulamu bw’Omukristaayo, mu bukulu bwabwo, bwe bulamu bwa Kristo obugenda mu maaso mu mukkiriza eyeewaayo gy’ali. Kino yakiggya butereevu mu kulangirira kwa Pawulo: “Nakomererwa wamu ne Kristo; kyokka ndi mulamu, si ku bwange, wabula ku bwa Kristo abeera mu nze;

era obulamu bwe nnina kaakano mu mubiri, mbulina lwa kukkiriza Omwana wa Katonda, eyanjagala ne yeewaayo yekka ku lwange” (Abaggalatiya 2:20). Oba nga Kristo yali abeera mu ye, kale okusaba kwe kwali kwa Kristo. Okwagala kwe eri abaana b’e Dohnavur kwali kwagala kwa Kristo okwabunanga okuyita mu mikono gye. Okubonaabona kwe kwali kussa kimu mu bibonoobono bya Kristo. Okwegatta kuno okw’obuntu bwe ne Kristo tekwali kirowoozo kya mu bbanga eri Carmichael, wabula kyali kya mazima ag’obulamu bwa buli lunaku, ag’omugaso era agamunyweza — omusingi omugumu wansi wa buli kye yakolanga.

fields.title: Corrie ten Boom — Okusaba mu Kisiikirize ky’Enkambi y’Okufa
fields.body_html:
Yali Ani

Cornelia “Corrie” ten Boom yazaalibwa nga 15 Apuli 1892, mu Amsterdam, mu Netherlands, n’akulira mu Haarlem, mu maka g’omukozi w’essaawa agaali gamanyiddwa mu kibuga kyonna olw’okukkiriza kwabwe mu Kristo n’okusembeza abagenyi. Yatendekebwa okukola essaawa — n’afuuka omukazi eyasooka mu Netherlands okuweebwa olukusa olutongole okukola omulimu ogwo — era n’abeera mu bulamu obukkakkamu obw’okutya Katonda okutuusa Abanazi lwe baawamba Holland. Okuva mu 1942 ab’omu maka ga ten Boom baakolagana n’abalwanirizi b’omu Holland ab’ekyama okukweka Abayudaaya abaali badduka, abamu ku bo nga bakwekebwa mu kasenge ak’ekyama akaali emabega wa bbugwe ow’obulimba mu kisenge Corrie mwe yasulanga; amakumiro g’ebyafaayo agakuuma ennyumba eyo gabalirira nti omukutu gwabwe gwayamba okuwonya abantu nga lunaana, abasinga obungi nga bakwekeddwa mu bifo ebirala eby’obukuumi, ab’omu maka ago nga tebannalibwamu lukwe ne bakwatibwa mu 1944. Corrie ne mwannyina gwe yali ayagala ennyo, Betsie, baatwalibwa mu nkambi y’abasibe eya Ravensbrück, Betsie gye yafiira mu Ddesemba 1944. Ku nkomerero y’omwezi ogwo Corrie yateebwa, olw’ensonga ezitannyonnyolwanga bulungi (oluvannyuma yatuuka okukkiriza nti yali nsobi ya mu biwandiiko), era mu wiiki ntono enkambi n’etandika okutta abalwadde n’abakadde n’omukka ogw’obutwa. Yamala emyaka egisukka amakumi asatu ng’atambula mu nsi ezisukka mu nkaaga, ng’anyumya kye yayita olugero olusinga obukulu mu nsi — nti tewali kinnya kiwanvu nnyo nga okwagala kwa Katonda tekukisinga buwanvu.

Enjigiriza Ye Enkulu ku Kusaba

Enjigiriza ya Corrie ten Boom ku kusaba teyazaalibwa mu tterekero ly’ebitabo, wabula mu kisulo ky’abasibe ekyali kijjudde enkukunyi e Ravensbrück, enkambi y’Abanazi ey’abasibe abakazi. Kye yazuula mu mbeera eyo kyali amazima ge yamala obulamu bwe bwonna ng’ategeeza abalala: nti okusaba si kikolwa ekisinziira ku mbeera, era nti Katonda atusisinkana mu kusaba takendeezebwa wadde okutwesuulira ewala olw’ekizikiza ky’embeera yaffe. Mu butuufu, yamusanga ng’ali kumpi naye mu kizikiza okusinga mu kitangaala.

Nga Corrie bw’anyumya mu Ekifo eky’Okwekwekamu (The Hiding Place), mwannyina Betsie yali amuyigirizza, mu kisulo ky’abasibe, okwebazanga mu buli kintu — ne ku lw’enkukunyi, ze baazuula nti ze zaali ensonga lwaki abakuumi beewalanga ekisulo kyabwe, ne kisobozesa okusoma Bayibuli n’enkuŋŋaana z’okusaba okugenda mu maaso awatali kutaataaganyizibwa. Kino kye kyali ekiragiro kya Pawulo nga kituukirizibwa ddala nga bwe kiri mu bigambo: “Temweraliikiriranga kintu na kimu, wabula mu buli kintu mu kusabanga ne mu kwegayiriranga awamu n’okwebazanga, mutegeezenga Katonda bye mwetaaga. N’emirembe gya Katonda, egisukkiridde okutegeera kwammwe ginaabakuumanga amagezi gammwe n’emitima gyammwe mu Kristo Yesu” (Abafiripi 4:6–7). Emirembe egyo Pawulo gy’ayogerako nti gisukkiridde okutegeera gye gyennyini Corrie ne Betsie gye baafuna e Ravensbrück — emirembe egitaalina makulu gonna okusinziira ku mbeera yaabwe, era olw’ensonga eyo ne giba obujulizi obutawakanyizika nti Katonda yali wamu nabo ng’akola.

Bwe yamala okuteebwa n’okutandika obuweereza bwe obw’okubuulira mu nsi yonna, Corrie yaddangayo emirundi mingi ku bye yayitamu mu nkambi, okusimba enjigiriza ye ku kusaba ku bujulizi obusinga obutawakanyizika bwe yalina: okuwonawo kwe yennyini. Yali atambulidde mu kiwonvu eky’ekisiikirize eky’olumbe, Omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli gwe yayogerako — si mu ngeri ya lufumo wabula ddala — era Omusumba yali awo.

Zabbuli 23:4 teyali bitontome bubeezi eri Corrie ten Boom: “Newaakubadde nga ntambulira mu kiwonvu eky’ekisiikirize eky’olumbe, siritya kabi konna; kubanga ggwe oli nange. Oluga lwo n’omuggo gwo bye binsanyusa” (Zabbuli 23:4). Oluga n’omuggo byali bimubudaabudde ng’ebyokulwanyisa by’abakuumi bimwolekezeddwa.

Yali ayiseeyo. Yali amanyi.

Ekimu ku bitundu by’obulamu bwa Corrie obw’okusaba ebyali eby’amaanyi ennyo kwali kwegezangamu okusonyiwa, mu kusaba, abo abaali bamukoze obubi — nga mw’otwalidde omukuumi Omugirimaani gwe yasisinkana oluvannyuma lw’olutalo, eyali amusibye e Ravensbrück, n’amusaba amusonyiwe. Yawandiika ku kaseera ako mu bwesimbu obw’amaanyi: teyali awulira kusonyiwa, naye n’asalawo okukukolerako, n’agolola omukono gwe mu kugondera ekiragiro kya Kristo, n’oluvannyuma n’awulira ebbugumu ery’okusonyiwa okw’amazima nga limujjulamu. Yeesigama ku kiragiro kya 1 Peetero: “Mumutwalirenga byonna bye mweraliikirira kubanga abalumirwa era afaayo ku buli ekibatuukako” (1 Peetero 5:7). Eri Corrie, okusaba kwali kikolwa kya kuta — okweraliikirira, obukaawu bw’omutima, okutya, n’ennaku — mu mikono gy’Oyo amaanyi ge ag’okubyetikka agasinga ewala nnyo amaanyi ge yalina.

Yategeezanga mu buweereza bwe bwonna nti kye yazuula mu nkambi y’okufa kwe kuba nti tewali buziba bwa kizikiza busobola kuzikiza kwagala kwa Katonda wadde okutaataaganya okusaba kw’omutima ogwewaddeyo.

Kino kye kyali, mu ngeri ye, ekirangiriro ekikulu ekya Pawulo: “Kubanga nkakasiza ddala nga newaakubadde okufa, wadde obulamu, wadde bamalayika, wadde abafuzi, wadde ebiriwo, wadde ebigenda okujja, wadde amaanyi, wadde obugulumivu, wadde okukka wansi, wadde ekitonde ekirala kyonna, tewali kiriyinza kutwawukanya n’okwagala kwa Katonda okuli mu Kristo Yesu Mukama waffe” (Abaruumi 8:38–39). Yali agezesezza ekisuubizo kino mu mbeera ezaali zitegekeddwa ddala okukiraga nti kya bulimba. Tekyalemererwa.

Ekigambo kya Corrie eky’okuzzaamu amaanyi abo abali mu kizikiza kyabwe bennyini kyali kye kimu bulijjo: saba kati, wakati mu kyo. Tolinda mbeera kulongooka. Katonda eyamusisinkana e Ravensbrück asisinkana abaana be wonna we bali. Yali ayagala nnyo ekisuubizo kya Isaaya: “Naye abo abalindirira Mukama baliddamu buggya amaanyi gaabwe, balitumbiira n’ebiwaawaatiro ng’empungu; balidduka mbiro ne batakoowa, balitambula naye ne batazirika” (Isaaya 40:31). Yakizuula nga kituufu mu kifo ekisinga obubi ku nsi. Yamala emyaka egisukka amakumi asatu ng’akirangirira eri ensi endala yonna.

Essaala

Mukama, wasisinkana Corrie mu kiwonvu eky’ebisiikirize, era osuubiza okutusisinkana mu byaffe. Embeera zaffe bwe zitutiisa, otujjukize nti oli dda mu zo. Obukaawu bw’omutima bwe bugezaako okusimba emirandira mu mitima gyaffe, otuwe ekisa okubuta mu mikono Gyo. Tuyigirize okusaba essaala ey’okwebaza ne mu bisulo ebijjudde enkukunyi eby’obulamu bwaffe, era otuleke tuzuule emirembe Gyo ku ludda olulala. Amiina.

Yamala emyaka egisukka amakumi asatu ng’atambula mu nsi ezisukka mu nkaaga, ng’anyumya kye yayita olugero olusinga obukulu mu nsi — nti tewali kinnya kiwanvu nnyo nga okwagala kwa Katonda tekukisinga buwanvu. Enjigiriza Ye Enkulu ku Kusaba Enjigiriza ya Corrie ten Boom ku kusaba teyazaalibwa mu tterekero ly’ebitabo, wabula mu kisulo ky’abasibe ekyali kijjudde enkukunyi e Ravensbrück, enkambi y’Abanazi ey’abasibe abakazi. Kye yazuula mu mbeera eyo kyali amazima ge yamala obulamu bwe bwonna ng’ategeeza abalala: nti okusaba si kikolwa ekisinziira ku mbeera, era nti Katonda atusisinkana mu kusaba takendeezebwa wadde okutwesuulira ewala olw’ekizikiza ky’embeera yaffe. Mu butuufu, yamusanga ng’ali kumpi naye mu kizikiza okusinga mu kitangaala. Nga Corrie bw’anyumya mu Ekifo eky’Okwekwekamu (The Hiding Place), mwannyina Betsie yali amuyigirizza, mu kisulo ky’abasibe, okwebazanga mu buli kintu — ne ku lw’enkukunyi, ze baazuula nti ze zaali ensonga lwaki abakuumi beewalanga ekisulo kyabwe, ne kisobozesa okusoma Bayibuli n’enkuŋŋaana z’okusaba okugenda mu maaso awatali kutaataaganyizibwa. Kino kye kyali ekiragiro kya Pawulo nga kituukirizibwa ddala nga bwe kiri mu bigambo: “Temweraliikiriranga kintu na kimu, wabula mu buli kintu mu kusabanga ne mu kwegayiriranga awamu n’okwebazanga, mutegeezenga Katonda bye mwetaaga. N’emirembe gya Katonda, egisukkiridde okutegeera kwammwe ginaabakuumanga amagezi gammwe n’emitima gyammwe mu Kristo Yesu” (Abafiripi 4:6–7). Emirembe egyo Pawulo gy’ayogerako nti gisukkiridde okutegeera gye gyennyini Corrie ne Betsie gye baafuna e Ravensbrück — emirembe egitaalina makulu gonna okusinziira ku mbeera yaabwe, era olw’ensonga eyo ne giba obujulizi obutawakanyizika nti Katonda yali wamu nabo ng’akola. Bwe yamala okuteebwa n’okutandika obuweereza bwe obw’okubuulira mu nsi yonna, Corrie yaddangayo emirundi mingi ku bye yayitamu mu nkambi, okusimba enjigiriza ye ku kusaba ku bujulizi obusinga obutawakanyizika bwe yalina: okuwonawo kwe yennyini. Yali atambulidde mu kiwonvu eky’ekisiikirize eky’olumbe, Omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli gwe yayogerako — si mu ngeri ya lufumo wabula ddala — era Omusumba yali awo. Zabbuli 23:4 teyali bitontome bubeezi eri Corrie ten Boom: “Newaakubadde nga ntambulira mu kiwonvu eky’ekisiikirize eky’olumbe, siritya kabi konna; kubanga ggwe oli nange. Oluga lwo n’omuggo gwo bye binsanyusa” (Zabbuli 23:4). Oluga n’omuggo byali bimubudaabudde ng’ebyokulwanyisa by’abakuumi bimwolekezeddwa. Yali ayiseeyo. Yali amanyi. Ekimu ku bitundu by’obulamu bwa Corrie obw’okusaba ebyali eby’amaanyi ennyo kwali kwegezangamu okusonyiwa, mu kusaba, abo abaali bamukoze obubi — nga mw’otwalidde omukuumi Omugirimaani gwe yasisinkana oluvannyuma lw’olutalo, eyali amusibye e Ravensbrück, n’amusaba amusonyiwe. Yawandiika ku kaseera ako mu bwesimbu obw’amaanyi: teyali awulira kusonyiwa, naye n’asalawo okukukolerako, n’agolola omukono gwe mu kugondera ekiragiro kya Kristo, n’oluvannyuma n’awulira ebbugumu ery’okusonyiwa okw’amazima nga limujjulamu. Yeesigama ku kiragiro kya 1 Peetero: “Mumutwalirenga byonna bye mweraliikirira kubanga abalumirwa era afaayo ku buli ekibatuukako” (1 Peetero 5:7). Eri Corrie, okusaba kwali kikolwa kya kuta — okweraliikirira, obukaawu bw’omutima, okutya, n’ennaku — mu mikono gy’Oyo amaanyi ge ag’okubyetikka agasinga ewala nnyo amaanyi ge yalina. Yategeezanga mu buweereza bwe bwonna nti kye yazuula mu nkambi y’okufa kwe kuba nti tewali buziba bwa kizikiza busobola kuzikiza kwagala kwa Katonda wadde okutaataaganya okusaba kw’omutima ogwewaddeyo. Kino kye kyali, mu ngeri ye, ekirangiriro ekikulu ekya Pawulo: “Kubanga nkakasiza ddala nga newaakubadde okufa, wadde obulamu, wadde bamalayika, wadde abafuzi, wadde ebiriwo, wadde ebigenda okujja, wadde amaanyi, wadde obugulumivu, wadde okukka wansi, wadde ekitonde ekirala kyonna, tewali kiriyinza kutwawukanya n’okwagala kwa Katonda okuli mu Kristo Yesu Mukama waffe” (Abaruumi 8:38–39). Yali agezesezza ekisuubizo kino mu mbeera ezaali zitegekeddwa ddala okukiraga nti kya bulimba. Tekyalemererwa. Ekigambo kya Corrie eky’okuzzaamu amaanyi abo abali mu kizikiza kyabwe bennyini kyali kye kimu bulijjo: saba kati, wakati mu kyo. Tolinda mbeera kulongooka. Katonda eyamusisinkana e Ravensbrück asisinkana abaana be wonna we bali. Yali ayagala nnyo ekisuubizo kya Isaaya: “Naye abo abalindirira Mukama baliddamu buggya amaanyi gaabwe, balitumbiira n’ebiwaawaatiro ng’empungu; balidduka mbiro ne batakoowa, balitambula naye ne batazirika” (Isaaya 40:31). Essaala Mukama, wasisinkana Corrie mu kiwonvu eky’ebisiikirize, era osuubiza okutusisinkana mu byaffe. Embeera zaffe bwe zitutiisa, otujjukize nti oli dda mu zo. Obukaawu bw’omutima bwe bugezaako okusimba emirandira mu mitima gyaffe, otuwe ekisa okubuta mu mikono Gyo. Tuyigirize okusaba essaala ey’okwebaza ne mu bisulo ebijjudde enkukunyi eby’obulamu bwaffe, era otuleke tuzuule emirembe Gyo ku ludda olulala. Amiina.

fields.title: Lottie Moon — Omukazi Eyawaayo Buli Kimu ku Lwa Bucayina
fields.body_html:
Yali Ani

Charlotte Diggs “Lottie” Moon yazaalibwa nga 12 Ddesemba 1840, e Viewmont, mu Virginia, mu maka g’Ababatista ag’obugagga era amanyifu. Yali omu ku bakazi abaasooka mu Bukiikaddyo bwa Amerika okufuna diguli ey’okubiri, era yalina amagezi amangi n’obuntu obw’amaanyi ebyandimuwadde obulamu obw’eddembe era obw’ekitiibwa mu by’ensoma. Naye mu 1873, yasaabala okugenda e Bucayina ng’atumiddwa Olukiiko lw’Obuminsani mu Nsi z’Ebweru olw’Ekibiina ky’Ababatista eky’omu Bukiikaddyo, n’amala emyaka amakumi ana egyaddirira egy’obulamu bwe e Tengchow n’oluvannyuma e Pingtu, ng’abuulira, ng’ayigiriza, era ng’abunyisa enjiri mu mbeera enzibu ennyo. Enjala bwe yagwa mu kitundu kya Shaanxi mu 1911–1912, Lottie yatandika okuwa baliraanwa be Abacayina abaali bafa enjala emmere ye ku bubwe, n’akikola okutuusa lwe yanafuwa ennyo olw’obutalya bulungi n’atasobola na kutambula. Yafa nga 24 Ddesemba 1912, ku meeri eyali emuzza ewaabwe, ng’azitowa wansi wa pawundi amakumi ataano. Leero, Ekirabo kya Ssekukkulu ekya Lottie Moon — ekisondebwa buli mwaka amakanisa g’Ababatista ag’omu Bukiikaddyo — kimaze okuwaayo ddoola ezisukka mu buwumbi buna eri emirimu gy’obuminsani mu nsi yonna.

Enjigiriza Ye Enkulu ku Kusaba

Enjigiriza ya Lottie Moon ku kusaba yali egattiddwa nnyo mu ndowooza ye ey’amaanyi ku buminsani. Yali tasobola kubyawula, kubanga yategeera okusaba ng’amafuta awatali go obuminsani tebwandibadde kirala wabula amaanyi g’omuntu obuntu, n’obuminsani ng’ekisaawe okusaba mwe kulagira amaanyi gaakwo agakyusa obulamu. Yayogeranga kaati ng’asaba amakanisa ag’ewaabwe: teyali ayagala ssente zokka. Yali ayagala okusaba. “Musabire Bucayina,” bwe yawandiikanga emirundi mingi. “Musabire abakozi.

Musabe Katonda ayite abalala bangi.” Yategeera Yesu kye yali ategeeza bwe yayogera ku kusaba n’obuminsani mu kigambo kye kimu.

Omutima gw’obuweereza bwa Lottie gwali kukkiriza nti Ekiragiro Ekikulu kyali buvunaanyizibwa bwa buli Mukristaayo, era nti okwegayiririra abalala abatannawulira njiri tekyali kya kweyagalira wabula kya buwaze. Yali akutte nnyo ekiragiro kya Yesu: “Eby’okukungula bingi nnyo, naye abakozi abakungula batono. Noolwekyo musabe nannyini nnimiro, aweereze abakozi mu nnimiro ye.” (Matayo 9:37–38). Yali asaba — buli kiseera, nga takoowa, mu bbaluwa ze ne mu kusaba kwe — abakozi abalala. Era ye kennyini yali okuddibwamu kw’okusaba kwe, ng’awaayo obulamu bwe bwonna awatali kusigaza kantu mu nnimiro Katonda gye yamuteeka.

Okwagala kwa Lottie okuwaayo obulamu bwe olw’abantu b’e Bucayina kwali kuzimbiddwa ku kutegeera okutangaavu okw’omusaalaba ng’ekyokulabirako ky’obulamu bw’omuminsani. Teyalowooza nti ssaddaaka ya kitiibwa kyokka; yagibala n’agikkiriza. Ebigambo bya Yesu bye byali obutume bwe: “Ddala ddala mbagamba nti empeke y’eŋŋaano bw’egwa mu ttaka efa, bwe tefa ebeera yokka, naye bw’efa ebala ebibala bingi.” (Yokaana 12:24). Ye yali empeke eyo ey’eŋŋaano. Yategeera nti okugenda mu ttaka tekwali nkomerero ya lugero wabula ye ntandikwa yaalwo. Okufa kwe — okw’omubiri, era okwamala emyaka amakumi — kwe kwali ensigo mwe mwandimeze amakungula ga ddoola obukadde n’obukadde olw’obuminsani mu nsi yonna.

Mu myaka egisinga obuzibu mu buweereza bwe, Abacayina bwe baali bamubuusabuusa era nga bamukyawa, enzigi nga nzigale ate omulimu nga gulabika nga tegubala, Lottie yeenyweza mu kusaba ng’akakasa nti Katonda teyamutuma mu kintu kya busirusiru. Yanywerera ku bwesige bwa Pawulo: “Enjiri tenkwasa nsonyi: kubanga ge maanyi ga Katonda agalokola buli muntu akkiriza” (Abaruumi 1:16). Amaanyi tegaali gage. Ye yali agatwala butwazi. Okusaba kwe kye kyali ekkubo mwe yasigalira ng’akwatagana n’ensibuko y’amaanyi ge yali atwala — era yali mwegendereza nnyo okukuuma okukwatagana okwo.

Lottie era yasabiranga abantu be yali agezaako okutuukako mu ngeri entongole ennyo. Yayiga olulimi, ne yeemalira mu buwangwa bwabwe, n’alya emmere yaabwe, n’ayambala engoye zaabwe, era n’atambulira mu makubo g’ebyalo by’essaza lya Shandong, okusaba kwe ku lw’abantu kinnoomu kube okusaba okuva mu kwagala n’okubamanya obulungi ennyo. Yeesigama ku Pawulo bwe yannyonnyola ensonga y’obuminsani: “Kale balikoowoola batya oyo gwe batakkiririzaamu? Era balikkiriza batya oyo gwe batawulirangako? Era baliwulira batya awatali abuulira? Era balibuulira batya nga tebatumiddwa?” (Abaruumi 10:14–15). Ye yali oyo eyatumibwa. Okusaba kwe kwali ekitundu ekitalabika eky’okubuulira kwe — ekikolwa omubaka omuntu mwe yasigalira ng’akwatagana n’ensibuko ey’obwakatonda.

Ekikolwa kye ekisembayo eky’okusaba kwali kufa kwe: okuwaayo omubiri gwe olw’okwagala abo abatalimanya linnya lye wadde okutegeera kye yabawa. Pawulo bwe yannyonnyola ekiwaliriza omuntu okwewaayo bw’atyo, kye kigambo ekisinga okunnyonnyola obulamu bwa Lottie: okwagala kwa Kristo “kutuwaliriza, ng’omu bwe yafiirira bonna, bonna kyebaava bafa.” (2 Abakkolinso 5:14). Yawalirizibwa. Si lwa kwewulira musango, si lwa buvunaanyizibwa, wabula lwa kwagala. Okwagala kwa Kristo gy’ali, era okuyita mu ye eri abantu b’e Bucayina.

Okusaba

Mukama w’amakungula, tuwe okwagala kwa Lottie — okwagala okubala omuwendo ate ne kugusasula. Gye tuli mu ddembe nga twesudde obwetaavu bw’ensi, tusiikuuse. Gye twekwata obutawaayo ssaddaaka, tulage omusaalaba. Yongera okwegayiririra kwaffe ku lw’abo abatannawulira njiri, era otuwe ffe, mu kigera kyaffe, okuwaayo nga ye bwe yawaayo — buli kimu, awatali kwejjusa, olw’okukwagala Ggwe n’okwagala abo be wajja okulokola. Amiina.

fields.title: Mary Slessor — Nnaabakyala Omuzungu Eyasaba Ebigo ne Bigwa
fields.body_html:
Ye Yali Ani

Mary Mitchell Slessor yazaalibwa nga 2 Desemba 1848, mu Aberdeen, mu Sukotolande, ng’ye mwana ow’okubiri ku baana musanvu ab’omukozi w’engatto, era obutamiivu bwa kitaawe bwaleeta ekisiikirize ekiwanvu ku buto bwe.

Yakola mu kkolero ly’engoye e Dundee okuva ku myaka kkumi n’ogumu ng’ayamba okulabirira ab’ewaabwe, ng’azuukuka ku makya ennyo okweyigiriza nga tannagenda ku mulimu. Okufa kwa David Livingstone mu 1873 bwe kwamukubiriza okuwaayo obulamu bwe eri Afirika, yasaba okwegatta ku Calabar Mission (mu Nayijeerya ey’olwaleero) n’atuukayo mu 1876. Mu myaka amakumi asatu mu munaana egyaddirira, yagenda yeeyongera munda mu bitundu ebyali bitannabuulirwamu Njiri, okutuusa lwe yasenga mu bantu b’Okoyong n’ab’Ibibio, awaali tewabeerangako Muzungu yenna. Yayiga ennimi zaabwe, n’agoberera empisa zaabwe, n’awonya abalongo bikumi na bikumi — abattibwanga nga baakazaalibwa, kubanga okusinziira ku nzikiriza z’omu kitundu baali kabonero ka kabi — era ne yeesigibwa nnyo ne kiba nti gavumenti ya Bungereza yamulonda okuba omulamuzi. Yafa nga 13 Janwali 1915, mu Use Ikot Oku, mu Nayijeerya, gye yali amaze emyaka mingi ng’abeera mu kayumba ak’ebbumba akaali ak’ekyangu ennyo, era yali amanyiddwa mu kitundu kyonna nga Ma — Maama.

Enjigiriza Ye Enkulu ku Kusaba

Mary Slessor yasabanga n’obwesimbu n’obwangu ebyafaanana embala ye. Yasabanga ng’afukamidde, yasabanga mu ddoboozi ery’omwanguka ekiro, yasabanga ku baana nga beebase, era yasabanga ng’ayimiridde wakati w’abalwanyi abakutte eby’okulwanyisa abaali bagenda okuttiŋŋana. fields.title: Gladys Aylward — Omuminsani Atasuubirwa Eyatambulira mu Kukkiriza
fields.body_html:
Yali Ani

Gladys May Aylward yazaalibwa nga 24 Febwali 1902, mu Edmonton, Middlesex, mu Bungereza, nga muwala w’omukozi wa poosita. Yakolanga ng’omukozi w’awaka, era yawuliranga okuyitibwa okutaggwaawo okugenda okukola omulimu gw’obuminsani mu Bucayina. Naye bwe yasaba okwegatta ku China Inland Mission mu 1929, baamugaana nga bagamba nti yali akaddiye nnyo okuyiga olulimi, era nti teyalina buyigirize obwetaagisa. Ekyo tekyamuggya ku mulamwa: yaterekanga empeera ye, era mu 1930 n’atambula yekka ng’ayita mu kkubo erisinga obuseere — ku ggaali y’omukka ng’ayita mu Siberia mu kiseera ky’olutalo wakati wa Bucayina ne Soviet — okutuuka e Yangcheng, mu ssaza ly’e Shanxi, omuminsani omukadde ayitibwa Jeannie Lawson gye yamwanirizza. Mu myaka egyaddirira, yafuuka nnannyini kisulo ky’abatambuze, omukebezi w’ebigere eyalondebwa gavumenti y’e Bucayina, era — ekisinga okumanyibwa — omukazi eyakulembera abaana bamulekwa nga kikumi mu 1940 okusomoka ensozi okutuuka mu kifo eky’obukuumi mu kiseera Abajapaani we baalumbira, olugendo lw’ennaku kkumi na bbiri ku bigere ng’asala ensozi z’e Shanxi. Obulamu bwe obwasigalawo yabumala ng’alabirira abaana b’e Bucayina, oluvannyuma ng’ali Taiwan, okutuusa lwe yafa mu 1970.

Enjigiriza Ye Enkulu ku Kusaba

Okusaba kwa Gladys Aylward kwali kwangu era kwa mutima gwonna. Yasabanga n’obwangu bw’omwana omuto n’obunyiikivu bw’omuserikale. Teyasoma by’eddiini mu ssomero lyonna, era teyalina bigambo bya bayivu eby’okwegayiririra abalala. Kye yalina bwe bukakafu obujjuvu obutaliiko kakwakkulizo nti Katonda amuwulira, nti afaayo ku nsonga ze ye kennyini, era nti ajja kukola kye yasuubiza.

Obukakafu buno tebwali bwa muntu atalina ky’amanyi; bwali kibala kye yafuna mu kuteganira ennyo, ng’alaba Katonda ng’amuwa by’ayagala, ng’amukuuma, era ng’amuluŋŋamya mu mbeera ezandimusaanyizzaawo, singa omuntu abalirira mu magezi g’abantu.

Okuva lwe yalinnya eggaali y’omukka egenda e Siberia, ng’abantu bonna bamuwabula obutagenda, era nga kumpi talina ssente, Gladys yali atambulira ku lunyiriri lumu olw’Ebyawandiikibwa lwe yaddangamu obulamu bwe bwonna: “Kubanga mmanyi enteekateeka ze nnina gye muli,” bw’ayogera Mukama, “enteekateeka ez’okubakulaakulanya so si okubakolako akabi, enteekateeka ez’okubawa essuubi era n’obulamu obw’omu maaso” (Yeremiya 29:11). China Inland Mission yali esazeewo nti talina biseera bya mu maaso mu Bucayina. Katonda yali asazeewo kirala. Yasabanga n’obwesige bw’omuntu ng’obulamu bwe buli munda mu nteekateeka ennene ennyo, erimu ekigendererwa ekinene ennyo, nga tesobola kuggwaawo lwa kugaanibwa kitongole kyonna wadde lwa kiziyiza kyonna.

Okusomoka ensozi n’abaana mu 1940 kikyali kimu ku bikolwa ebisinga okwewuunyisa eby’okukkiriza mu kusaba mu byafaayo by’obuminsani mu kyasa eky’amakumi abiri. Bwe baatuuka ku Mugga Omuyenvu nga tebalina lyato era nga tebalina baserikale babawerekera, Gladys yasaba n’alindirira. Oluvannyuma omukulu w’amagye Omucayina ow’eggye lya Nationalist yatuuka n’abaserikale be, ne babasomosa. Yali asabye busabi era ne yeesiga. Okusaba kwe kwali kwesigamye ku bwesige bw’omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli: “Nnyimusa amaaso gange eri ensozi, okubeerwa kwange kuva wa? Okubeerwa kwange kuva eri Mukama, eyakola eggulu n’ensi” (Zabbuli 121:1–2). Okubeerwa kwe kwava ddala eri Mukama. Kwajja mu kifaananyi ky’omukulu w’amagye Omucayina n’abaserikale be, naye ensibuko yaakwo yali Katonda gwe yali yeegayirira okuva edda ennyo nga tebannatuuka ku mugga.

Gladys yasabanga ng’asuubira eby’amagero, ekintu ekyandirabise ng’okwekulumbaza mu muntu alina obujulizi obutono. Naye ye yalina obujulizi. Yali alabye Katonda ng’awa emmere, ng’awonya abalwadde, ng’akkakkanya abasibe abaali bajeemye, era ng’amukuuma mu kubwatuka kw’emizinga. Okusaba kwe kwali kwa muntu eyali akakasizza emirundi mingi ekisuubizo kya Yesu: “Buli kimu kisoboka eri oyo akkiriza” (Makko 9:23). Yakkiriza. Era yali alabye ebitasoboka nga bifuuka ebisoboka emirundi mingi ekimala, okukkiriza kwe ne kulekera awo okuba okw’ebirowoozo obulowoozo. Yalina ebyafaayo bye yayitamu ne Katonda w’ebitasoboka, era ebyafaayo ebyo yabyesigamangako mu kusaba n’obwesige obwangu bw’omukazi eyali ayize mu bye yayitamu nti Katonda yeesigika.

Kimu ku bintu ebyaddiŋŋananga mu bulamu bwe obw’okusaba kwe kwali okukkiriza Katonda okumukulembera mu mbeera ezitaalina makulu ng’olaba n’amaaso g’omuntu. Teyali ateeseteese kufuuka mukebezi wa bigere, wadde nnannyini kisulo, wadde omulezi w’abaana bamulekwa kikumi. Naye buli ddaala lyali kukulembera kwa Katonda, era yakugobereranga mu kusaba. Yakwata ku mutima ekiragiro ky’Engero: “Weesige Mukama n’omutima gwo gwonna, so teweesigamanga ku magezi go gokka. Mukama mukulembezenga mu by’okola byonna, naye anaakuluŋŋamyanga n’owangula” (Engero 3:5–6). Ekkubo lye teryali ttereevu n’akatono ng’olabira mu magezi g’abantu, kyokka mu maaso ga Katonda lyali ttereevu ddala — nga lyolekera ebigendererwa bye yali ateekateeka nga tannazaalibwa.

Ebyafaayo bya Gladys Aylward kye kimu ku bikakasa ebisinga obukulu nti Katonda tayita abo abalina ebisaanyizo; abo b’ayise y’abawa ebisaanyizo. Omukozi w’awaka akakiiko k’obuminsani ke kaagaana yafuuka omu ku baminsani Abakristaayo abasinga okutenderezebwa mu kyasa eky’amakumi abiri — si lwa buyigirize bwe, wabula lwa kusaba kwe. Yatuukiriza mu bulamu bwe ekyo Pawulo kye yalangirira: “Kubanga tutambula lwa kukkiriza so si lw’amaaso gaffe bye galaba” (2 Abakkolinso 5:7). Teyasobolanga kulaba kkubo lyonna. Teyasobolanga kutegeera nteekateeka yonna. Naye yasabanga n’atambula, ekkubo ne lirabika wansi w’ebigere bye.

Essaala

Mukama, toyita abo abalina ebisaanyizo — abo b’oyise ggwe obawa ebisaanyizo. Bwe tuwulira nga tetusaanira, otujjukize nti amaanyi go tegakomezebwa busobozi bwaffe. Ekkubo ery’omu maaso bwe litategeerekeka, otuwe okukkiriza kwa Gladys okwangu era okutakyukakyuka: okuyimusa amaaso gaffe eri ensozi, n’okwesiga nti okubeerwa kwaffe kuva gy’oli. Otuwe obuvumu okutambulira mu bitasoboka, nga tusaba nga bwe tugenda. Amiina.

Kye yalina bwe bukakafu obujjuvu obutaliiko kakwakkulizo nti Katonda amuwulira, nti afaayo ku nsonga ze ye kennyini, era nti ajja kukola kye yasuubiza. Obukakafu buno tebwali bwa muntu atalina ky’amanyi; bwali kibala kye yafuna mu kuteganira ennyo, ng’alaba Katonda ng’amuwa by’ayagala, ng’amukuuma, era ng’amuluŋŋamya mu mbeera ezandimusaanyizzaawo, singa omuntu abalirira mu magezi g’abantu. Okuva lwe yalinnya eggaali y’omukka egenda e Siberia, ng’abantu bonna bamuwabula obutagenda, era nga kumpi talina ssente, Gladys yali atambulira ku lunyiriri lumu olw’Ebyawandiikibwa lwe yaddangamu obulamu bwe bwonna: “Kubanga mmanyi enteekateeka ze nnina gye muli,” bw’ayogera Mukama, “enteekateeka ez’okubakulaakulanya so si okubakolako akabi, enteekateeka ez’okubawa essuubi era n’obulamu obw’omu maaso” (Yeremiya 29:11). China Inland Mission yali esazeewo nti talina biseera bya mu maaso mu Bucayina. Katonda yali asazeewo kirala. Yasabanga n’obwesige bw’omuntu ng’obulamu bwe buli munda mu nteekateeka ennene ennyo, erimu ekigendererwa ekinene ennyo, nga tesobola kuggwaawo lwa kugaanibwa kitongole kyonna wadde lwa kiziyiza kyonna. Okusomoka ensozi n’abaana mu 1940 kikyali kimu ku bikolwa ebisinga okwewuunyisa eby’okukkiriza mu kusaba mu byafaayo by’obuminsani mu kyasa eky’amakumi abiri. Bwe baatuuka ku Mugga Omuyenvu nga tebalina lyato era nga tebalina baserikale babawerekera, Gladys yasaba n’alindirira. Oluvannyuma omukulu w’amagye Omucayina ow’eggye lya Nationalist yatuuka n’abaserikale be, ne babasomosa. Yali asabye busabi era ne yeesiga. Okusaba kwe kwali kwesigamye ku bwesige bw’omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli: “Nnyimusa amaaso gange eri ensozi, okubeerwa kwange kuva wa? Kwajja mu kifaananyi ky’omukulu w’amagye Omucayina n’abaserikale be, naye ensibuko yaakwo yali Katonda gwe yali yeegayirira okuva edda ennyo nga tebannatuuka ku mugga. Gladys yasabanga ng’asuubira eby’amagero, ekintu ekyandirabise ng’okwekulumbaza mu muntu alina obujulizi obutono. Naye ye yalina obujulizi. Yali alabye Katonda ng’awa emmere, ng’awonya abalwadde, ng’akkakkanya abasibe abaali bajeemye, era ng’amukuuma mu kubwatuka kw’emizinga. Okusaba kwe kwali kwa muntu eyali akakasizza emirundi mingi ekisuubizo kya Yesu: “Buli kimu kisoboka eri oyo akkiriza” (Makko 9:23). Yakkiriza. Era yali alabye ebitasoboka nga bifuuka ebisoboka emirundi mingi ekimala, okukkiriza kwe ne kulekera awo okuba okw’ebirowoozo obulowoozo. Yalina ebyafaayo bye yayitamu ne Katonda w’ebitasoboka, era ebyafaayo ebyo yabyesigamangako mu kusaba n’obwesige obwangu bw’omukazi eyali ayize mu bye yayitamu nti Katonda yeesigika. Kimu ku bintu ebyaddiŋŋananga mu bulamu bwe obw’okusaba kwe kwali okukkiriza Katonda okumukulembera mu mbeera ezitaalina makulu ng’olaba n’amaaso g’omuntu. Teyali ateeseteese kufuuka mukebezi wa bigere, wadde nnannyini kisulo, wadde omulezi w’abaana bamulekwa kikumi. Naye buli ddaala lyali kukulembera kwa Katonda, era yakugobereranga mu kusaba. Ebyafaayo bya Gladys Aylward kye kimu ku bikakasa ebisinga obukulu nti Katonda tayita abo abalina ebisaanyizo; abo b’ayise y’abawa ebisaanyizo. Teyasobolanga kutegeera nteekateeka yonna. Naye yasabanga n’atambula, ekkubo ne lirabika wansi w’ebigere bye. Essaala Mukama, toyita abo abalina ebisaanyizo — abo b’oyise ggwe obawa ebisaanyizo. Bwe tuwulira nga tetusaanira, otujjukize nti amaanyi go tegakomezebwa busobozi bwaffe. Ekkubo ery’omu maaso bwe litategeerekeka, otuwe okukkiriza kwa Gladys okwangu era okutakyukakyuka: okuyimusa amaaso gaffe eri ensozi, n’okwesiga nti okubeerwa kwaffe kuva gy’oli. Otuwe obuvumu okutambulira mu bitasoboka, nga tusaba nga bwe tugenda. Amiina.

fields.title: Evelyn Christenson — Ekibaawo Abakazi Bwe Basaba
fields.body_html:
Yali Ani

Evelyn Maxine Wheeler Christenson yazaalibwa nga 1 Novemba 1922, mu Muskegon, Michigan, era obulamu bwe obw’obukulu yabumala nga mukyala w’omusumba, ng’alera abaana basatu era ng’aweereza mu mirimu gy’ekkanisa ey’ewaabwe. Mu 1968, yakulembera omusomo omutono ogw’okusaba ogw’abakazi ogwamala wiiki mukaaga mu kkanisa ye ey’omu St.

Paul, Minnesota, era ne guvaamu ebibala eby’amaanyi ennyo n’ayitibwa okuguddamu mu ggwanga lyonna, oluvannyuma ne mu mawanga amalala. Ekitabo kye “Ekibaawo Abakazi Bwe Basaba,” ekyafulumizibwa mu 1975, kyafuuka kimu ku bitabo ebyasomebwa ennyo ku kusaba mu kyasa eky’amakumi abiri, era ku nkomerero kyatunda kopi ezisukka mu bukadde bubiri. Yatandikawo United Prayer Ministries, n’amala emyaka amakumi ana egyaddirira ng’ayigiriza ku kusaba mu makanisa, mu nkuŋŋaana ne mu bitundu eby’enjawulo mu nsi yonna, era kigambibwa nti yatendeka abakazi obukadde nga kkumi na butaano mu misingi gy’okusabira awamu n’okusaba kw’omuntu kinnoomu, nga tannafa mu 2013. Teyali mukugu mu by’eddiini eyasomera mu ttendekero ly’eby’eddiini, wadde omubuulizi omututumufu; yali mukyala w’omusumba eyabuuza ekibuuzo ekyangu, n’awaayo obulamu bwe eri eky’okuddamu kyakyo.

Okuyigiriza Kwe Okukulu ku Kusaba

Okuyigiriza kwa Evelyn Christenson ku kusaba kwazimbibwa ku kibuuzo ekisingayo obwangu: kiki ddala ekibaawo bwe tusaba? Si ekyandibaddewo okusinziira ku by’eddiini, si ekyabaawo mu byafaayo mu kuzuukuka okwatutumuka, wabula ekibaawo kaakano, mu makanisa aga bulijjo, Abakristaayo aba bulijjo bwe basabira wamu n’okukkiriza okwa nnamaddala. Eky’okuddamu kye, kye yafuna okuva mu myaka mingi egy’okwerabirako n’amaaso ge, kyali kimu bulijjo era nga kimatiza: ebintu ebitali bya bulijjo bibaawo. Bbugwe zigwa.

Enkolagana ziwonyezebwa. Emize egitufuga gimenyebwa. Amakanisa gakyusibwa. Ebitundu bikyuka. Okusaba kukola — era obukakafu bwakyo buli mu ngalo za buli muntu eyetegefu okusaba ebbanga eddene ekimala okulaba ebivaamu.

Ekyawandiikibwa kye ekyali omusingi kyali ekisuubizo ekikulu ekya Yakobo, kye yajulizanga kumpi mu buli musomo, mu buli kitabo, ne mu buli kakisa k’okuyigiriza: “Okusaba n’omutima omumalirivu ogw’omuntu omutuukirivu, kubeera n’obuyinza bungi, era n’ebivaamu biba bya ttendo” (Yakobo 5:16). Obuweereza bwe bwonna yabuzimba ku kukkiriza nti ebigambo bino si bya kwegomba bwegomba, wabula ennyinnyonnyola ya mazima ey’ebintu nga bwe biri. Okusaba tekwali kwa makulu mu by’omwoyo kyokka; kwalina amaanyi agaleeta ebivaamu. Ebintu byabangawo nga kiva butereevu ku kusaba, ebitandibaddewo singa tekwaliwo. Okukkiriza kuno tekwali kwa kyama, wabula kwali kwa nkola, nga kwesigamye ku Byawandiikibwa era nga kukakasibwa obujulirwa enkumi n’enkumi bwe yakuŋŋaanya okuva eri abakazi abaali basabye ne balaba Katonda ng’addamu.

Ekimu ku bintu ebisinga obukulu Christenson bye yawaayo kwali kuzzaawo enkola y’Endagaano Empya ey’okusabira awamu. Yalaba nti Ekkanisa eyasooka — okuva ku lukuŋŋaana lw’okusaba mu kisenge ekya waggulu nga Pentekooti tennatuuka, okuyita mu kitabo kyonna eky’Ebikolwa by’Abatume — yasabiranga wamu ng’ekibiina, so si buli muntu yekka ku bubwe. Yalaga abayizi be ekisuubizo eky’ekitalo ekigattibwa ku nkola eno: “Era ddala ddala mbagamba nti bwe munaabanga babiri mu nsi ne mukkiriziganya ku ekyo kye mwagala okusaba, Kitange ali mu ggulu alikibakolera. Kubanga abantu ababiri oba abasatu bwe banaakuŋŋaananga mu linnya lyange, nange nnaabeeranga awo wakati waabwe.” (Matayo 18:19–20). Okukuŋŋaana kw’abantu ababiri oba abasatu mu kusaba tekwali kya kubudaabuda bubudaabuzi olw’obutaba na bibiina binene — yali nteekateeka ey’enjawulo era ey’amaanyi Kristo gye yakakasa ye kennyini olw’okubeerawo kwe. Christenson yamala obuweereza bwe ng’akunga ababiri abo n’abasatu abo.

Okuyigiriza kwe ku kuwuliriza mu kusaba — ekitundu eky’okubiri eky’emboozi ekitera okulagajjalirwa — kwali kwa mugaso nnyo. Yalaba nti abantu abasinga bajja mu kusaba n’olukalala lw’ebyo bye basaba, ne bagenda olukalala bwe luggwaawo, nga tebalindiridde kuwulira Katonda ky’ayinza okwagala okwogera. Yakubiriza abayizi be okwegezangamu empisa ey’okusirika mu kusaba, “okusaba okw’enjuuyi ebbiri” omukkiriza mw’ayogerera n’oluvannyuma n’alindirira. Kino yakyesigamya ku kiragiro kya 1 Yokaana: “Noolwekyo tulina obuvumu nti bwe tugenda gy’ali ne tumusaba ekintu kyonna, ye nga bw’asiima atuwulira. Era bwe tutegeera nti atuwulira bwe tumusaba, buli kye tumusaba talema kukituwa” (1 Yokaana 5:14–15). Okusaba nga bw’asiima kwetaaga okusooka okumanya by’asiima — era okumanya by’asiima kwetaaga okuwuliriza.

Christenson era yayigirizanga obutakoowa ku nkolagana wakati w’okusaba n’obutukuvu bw’omuntu kinnoomu.

Yali alabye nti obulamu bw’okusaba bw’Abakristaayo abasinga bwalemesebwanga si lwa kubulwa bukodyo oba kumanya, wabula lwa bibi ebitaatulwanga n’enkolagana ezaayonooneka ezitaagonjoolwa, ebyaziyizanga empuliziganya ne Katonda okutambula obulungi. Yeesigama ku kiragiro kya Pawulo eri abakkiriza ab’e Kolosaayi: “Munyiikirirenga mu kusaba, nga temuddirira, wabula nga mwebazanga” (Abakkolosaayi 4:2).

“Obutaddirira” Pawulo bwe yayogerako bwazingiramu n’okutunula ku bulamu obw’omunda — endowooza, ebiruyi, amalala, n’okwerimba, ebyo bwe bitakolebwako, binafuya mu kasirise obulamu bw’okusaba nga biva munda.

Ky’alekedde ensi ekiwangaala bye bibiina by’okusaba obusiriivu n’obusiriivu ebyatandikibwawo olw’okuyigiriza kwe, ebyagenda mu maaso ebbanga ddene oluvannyuma lw’omusomo ogwasooka, nga biwaniriddwa ebibiina by’abakazi abaali beerabiddeko bokka nti ensonga ye ennyangu yali ya mazima. Teyabasuubiza bumanyirivu bwa kyama oba ebyamagero eby’ekitalo; yabayita buyisi okusaba n’okulaba Katonda ky’anaakola. Ne basaba. Ne balaba. Ne beeyongera okusaba. Enkola y’Ekkanisa eyasooka yali yiye: “Ne banyiikiranga okuyigirizibwa kw’abatume ne mu kussekimu, ne mu kumenya omugaati era ne mu kusaba” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 2:42). Okwewaayo eri okusaba, nga kukolebwa wamu, kukyusa buli kye kukwatako.

Essaala

Mukama, tufuule abakazi n’abasajja abasaba — era abeeyongera okusaba. Tuyigirize okukuŋŋaana ne bwe tuba ababiri oba abasatu bokka mu linnya lyo, n’okwesiga nti oli wakati waffe era ng’okola.

Tulage si kwogera kyokka bye tusaba, naye n’okuwuliriza by’oddamu.

Obulamu bwaffe obw’okusaba bwe buba bunafu era nga tebutera kubaawo, bwongere obuziba. Bwe tuba twawukanye n’abalala, tuwe omubiri gwa Kristo okusabira awamu naffe. Era tukkirize tuzuule, nga Evelyn bwe yazuula, ekibaawo abantu bo bwe basaba ddala. Amiina.

fields.title: Enkomerero: Okuyita Kukyaliwo
fields.body_html:
Kaakano osisinkanye abakazi kkumi abaalina obulamu obw’enjawulo, era ebyafaayo bikakasizza nti bwali bwa kitalo. Amaziga ga Monika gaazaala omukugu mu by’eddiini akyakwata ku bantu n’okutuusa leero. Ekigo eky’omunda ekya Teresa kikyalung’amya abanoonya Katonda ebyasa bingi oluvannyuma lw’okufa kwe. Ekisenge ky’okusaba ekya Susanna mu maka ge kyakoleeza okuzuukuka okwabuna ensi yonna eyogera Olungereza. Ebiwandiiko bya Madame Guyon bye yawandiikira mu kkomera lya Bastille bitegeezezza abasomi bukadde na bukadde obuziba bw’okusaba okw’okufumiitiriza.

Emyaka ataano mu etaano Amy Carmichael gye yamala ng’aweereza mu Buyindi awatali kuwummula gikyagenda mu maaso n’okuzzaamu amaanyi n’okunenya abo abasoma ebimukwatako. Obujulirwa bwa Corrie ten Boom okuva e Ravensbrück buzzizzaamu amaanyi okukkiriza kw’abantu abatabalika abayita mu biwonvu byabwe eby’ekisiikirize. Okufa kwa Lottie Moon okw’okwewaayo kwasimba ensigo y’ekiweebwayo eky’obuminsani ekiwagidde abakozi enkumi n’enkumi mu nsi yonna. Obuvumu bwa Mary Slessor mu bantu b’e Calabar abaasalanga emitwe gy’abantu bwaggulawo ekitundu kyonna eri enjiri.

Gladys Aylward okusomoka ensozi n’abaana kikumi kikyali kimu ku bikolwa ebisinga obukulu eby’okukkiriza ebyali biwandiikiddwa mu byafaayo. Ekibuuzo ekyangu ekya Evelyn Christenson kikunze abantu abateeberezebwa okuba obukadde kkumi na butaano okusaba.

Obulamu ng’obwo obukolera ki? Toyinza kubwegomba bwegomba ng’oli wala, kubanga buli omu ku bo yandigaanye okwegombebwa okwo. Buli omu ku bo, mu ngeri ye, yandizzizza buli kitiibwa eri Katonda eyali addamu okusaba kwe, eyamuwa okukkiriza okusaba bw’atyo, era eyaleeta ebyavaamu abalala bye baali batendereza kaakano. Bonna, awatali n’omu, baali bakakafu nnyo nti kye baali bazudde kyali kya buli muntu — nti Katonda eyabasisinkana mu byasa byabwe, mu buwangwa bwabwe ne mu mbeera zaabwe ez’enjawulo, ye Katonda y’omu ali eri buli muntu yenna eyeetegefu okumunoonya.

Ekyo kye kintu ekisinga obukulu ekitabo kino kye kigezaako okwogera. Abakazi bano ekkumi tebaali ba njawulo lwa kuba nti baalina ekirabo eky’omwoyo abantu abasinga obungi kye batalina. Baali ba njawulo kubanga baakwata Katonda ku kigambo kye bwe yagamba nti: “Mulinnoonya ne mundaba bwe mulinnoonya n’omutima gwammwe gwonna” (Yeremiya 29:13). Baamunoonya n’emitima gyabwe gyonna. Era baamulaba. Ekisuubizo tekiggyiddwawo. Kikyaliwo leero nga bwe kyali nga Monika akaaba amaziga e Carthage, nga Teresa asaba e Ávila, nga Susanna yeebikka epuloni ye ku mutwe e Epworth, nga Gladys asaba ku Mugga Omuyenvu. Okuyita kukyaliwo.

Oboolyawo osomye ekitabo kino kubanga okusaba kubadde kukuzibuwalira. Oboolyawo kubadde kukalu, kwa mpisa buli, oba nga tekuliiwo n’akatono mu bulamu bwo — omuze gw’omwoyo gw’omanyi nti olina okugukola naye ne weesanga ng’oddiŋŋana okulemererwa okugunywererako. Bwe kiba bwe kityo, abakazi bano ekkumi balina obubaka gy’oli: tandika buggya. Tandika kaakano. Katonda eyasisinkana Corrie ten Boom mu nkambi y’abasibe takulindirira kusooka kutuuka ku ddaala lya by’omwoyo erigere alyoke akusisinkane. Akusisinkana w’oli. Akkiriza okusaba okumenyefu, okw’okuwankawanka, okw’eddakiika ttaano okw’omuntu atandika, n’okwagala okwo kwe kumu okussaayo omwoyo kwe yakkirizaamu ebiro ebiwanvu John Hyde bye yamalanga nga yeegayiririra abalala.

Oboolyawo osomye ekitabo kino kubanga dda oli muntu wa kusaba, ng’onoonya okuzzibwamu amaanyi n’eby’okulabirako okugenda mu buziba. Bwe kiba bwe kityo, abakazi ekkumi abali mu mpapula zino bakuyita okuyingira ennyo munda. Bulijjo wabaawo ebisingawo. Teresa ow’e Ávila yannyonnyola ebisenge munda mu bisenge munda mu bisenge mu kigo eky’omunda eky’emmeeme, era yali abiyiseemu byonna — era emitala w’ekisenge ekisembayo teyasangayo bbugwe wabula omulyango oguggukira mu ekyo ekitaliiko kkomo. Tewali muntu amalayo Katonda. Tewali atuuka ku nkomerero y’ebyo okusaba bye kuyinza okuzuula oba okutuukiriza. Bulijjo waliwo amazzi amawanvu okusingawo ag’okuwugiramu.

Eri buli musomi, k’obe ng’otandikira wa, okuyita kwe kumu. Tekuzibu. Tekwetaagisa diguli mu by’eddiini, mukulembeze wa by’omwoyo akulung’amya, oba empisa ey’enjawulo. Kwetaagisa ekyo kyokka abakazi bano ekkumi kye baakuleetamu: obwesimbu, okugumiikiriza, n’okwagala okukwata Katonda ku kigambo kye. Yesu yakyogera mu ngeri ennyangu nga bwe kiyinza okwogerwa: “Musabe, munaaweebwa. Munoonye, munaazuula. Era mukonkone munaggulirwawo. Kubanga buli asaba aweebwa, n’oyo anoonya, azuula, n’oyo akonkona aggulirwawo” (Matayo 7:7–8).

Buli muntu. Si abo abalina ebirabo eby’omwoyo. Si abo abaagala okwawukana n’ensi mu bigo by’eddiini. Si abo abasomesebwa eby’eddiini.

Buli asaba aweebwa. Buli anoonya azuula. Buli akonkona aliggulirwawo. Monika yasaba. Teresa yanoonya. Susanna yakonkona. Buli omu ku bo yaggulirwawo. Naawe ojja kuggulirwawo.

“Mulinnoonya ne mundaba bwe mulinnoonya n’omutima gwammwe gwonna.”

— Yeremiya 29:13
