fields.title: Ebyawandiikibwa Ebyongerezeddwako: Okusaba mu Kigambo kya Katonda
fields.body_html:
Ebyawandiikibwa bino ebikwata ku kusaba bijuliziddwa mu kitabo kino kyonna. Ennyiriri zonna wano ziggiddwa mu Bayibuli mu Luganda Olwa Leero.

Ennyanjula

Yoweeri 2:28–29 — “Batabani bammwe ne bawala bammwe balitegeeza eby’omu maaso; abakadde baliroota ebirooto, n’abavubuka bammwe balyolesebwa. Mu biro ebyo ndifuka Omwoyo wange ku baweereza bange abasajja n’abakazi.”

Ebikolwa by’Abatume 16:13 — “Gye baali batutegeezezza nti waliwo abakuŋŋaanirayo okusabirayo. Ne tutuula wamu n’abakazi abaali bazze okusaba ne twogera nabo.”

Yokaana 16:23–24 — “Mu kiseera ekyo nga temukyansaba kintu na kimu, mmwe bennyini munaasabanga Kitange mu linnya lyange. Kino mubadde temukikola, naye kaakano mukitandike. Musabe mu linnya lyange, mujja kuweebwa ekyo kye musaba, essanyu lyammwe liryoke lituukirire.”

Abakkolosaayi 4:2 — “Munyiikirirenga mu kusaba, nga temuddirira, wabula nga mwebazanga.”

Essuula 1 — Monika ow’e Hippo

Lukka 18:1 — “Nga bwe bagwanidde obutakoowanga kusaba n’obutaggwaamu mwoyo.”

Zabbuli 56:8 — “Emirundi gye ntawaanyizibwa nga njaziirana ogimanyi; amaziga gange gateeke mu ccupa yo! Wagawandiika.” 1 Timoseewo 2:1–4 — “Okusookera ddala, mbasaba, musabenga, mwegayirirenga, era mwebazenga Katonda ku lw’abantu bonna. Era musabirenga bakabaka n’abafuzi abalala bonna, tulyoke tube bulungi nga tuli mirembe, nga tussaamu Katonda ekitiibwa, era nga twegendereza mu buli ngeri. Ekyo kirungi era ekisiimibwa mu maaso ga Katonda Omulokozi waffe, ayagala abantu bonna balokolebwe, era bategeere amazima.”

Okukungubaga 2:19 — “Golokoka, okaabe ekiro obudde nga bwa kaziba; Fuka emmeeme yo ng’amazzi mu maaso ga Mukama.”

Zabbuli 126:5–6 — “Abo abasiga nga bakaaba amaziga, baliyimba ennyimba ez’essanyu nga bakungula. Oyo agenda ng’akaaba ng’atwala ensigo okusiga; alikomawo ng’ayimba ennyimba ez’essanyu ng’aleeta ebinywa bye.”

Essuula 2 — Teresa ow’e Ávila

Matayo 6:6 — “Naye ggwe bw’obanga osaba, oyingiranga mu nnyumba yo, ne weggalira mu kisenge kyo n’osabira eyo mu kyama. Kitaawo ategeera ebyama byo byonna alikuwa by’omusabye.”

Zabbuli 46:10 — “Musiriikirire mutegeere nga nze Katonda.”

2 Abakkolinso 12:9 — “Buli mulundi ng’aŋŋamba nti, ‘Ekisa kyange kikumala, kubanga amaanyi gange gatuukirira mu bunafu.’ Noolwekyo kyennaavanga nneegulumiza n’essanyu lingi olw’obunafu bwange, amaanyi ga Kristo galyoke galabisibwe.”

Yokaana 15:5 — “Kubanga awatali Nze temuliiko kye muyinza kukola.”

Essuula 3 — Susanna Wesley

Engero 22:6 — “Manyiiriza omwana mu kkubo erimugwanira okutambulirangamu, ne bw’alikula talirivaamu.”

Zabbuli 119:147 — “Ngolokoka bunatera okukya ne nkukaabirira onnyambe; essuubi lyange liri mu kigambo kyo.”

Yeremiya 29:11 — “Kubanga mmanyi enteekateeka ze nnina gye muli,” bw’ayogera Mukama, “enteekateeka ez’okubakulaakulanya so si okubakolako akabi, enteekateeka ez’okubawa essuubi era n’obulamu obw’omu maaso.”

Matayo 18:20 — “Kubanga abantu ababiri oba abasatu bwe banaakuŋŋaananga mu linnya lyange, nange nnaabeeranga awo wakati waabwe.”

Yoswa 24:15 — “Nze n’ennyumba yange, ffe tunaaweerezanga Mukama Katonda.”

Essuula 4 — Madame Guyon

Abafiripi 4:11–12 — “Mu buli mbeera gye mbaamu nayiga okumalibwanga. Mmanyi okubeera nga sirina kantu, era mmanyi okuba nga nnina buli kimu.”

Yokaana 15:15 — “Olwo nga sikyabayita baddu, kubanga omuddu tamanya bifa ku mukama we. Kaakano mmwe muli mikwano gyange, kubanga mbategeezezza byonna Kitange bye yaŋŋamba.”

Isaaya 43:2 — “Bw’onooyitanga mu mazzi amawanvu nnaabeeranga naawe, ne bw’onooyitanga mu migga tegirikusaanyaawo; bw’onooyitanga mu muliro tegukwokyenga, ennimi z’omuliro tezirikwokya.”

Abafiripi 4:7 — “N’emirembe gya Katonda, egisukkiridde okutegeera kwammwe ginaabakuumanga amagezi gammwe n’emitima gyammwe mu Kristo Yesu.”

2 Abakkolinso 3:17 — “Kale nno Mukama ye Mwoyo, era buli Omwoyo wa Mukama w’abeera, wabaawo eddembe.”

Essuula 5 — Amy Carmichael

Abaggalatiya 2:20 — “Nakomererwa wamu ne Kristo; kyokka ndi mulamu, si ku bwange, wabula ku bwa Kristo abeera mu nze; era obulamu bwe nnina kaakano mu mubiri, mbulina lwa kukkiriza Omwana wa Katonda, eyanjagala ne yeewaayo yekka ku lwange.”

Lukka 10:2 — “Eby’okukungula bingi, naye abakozi abakungula batono. Noolwekyo musabe nannyini nnimiro, aweereze abakozi mu nnimiro ye.”

Isaaya 41:10 — “Totya kubanga nze ndi wamu naawe; tokeŋŋentererwa, kubanga nze Katonda wo. Nnaakuwanga amaanyi. Wewaawo nnaakuyambanga n’omukono ogwa ddyo ogw’obutuukirivu bwange.”

Lukka 9:23 — “Omuntu yenna ayagala okungoberera asaana yeefiirize yekka yeetikke omusaalaba gwe buli lunaku, angoberere!”

Abaruumi 8:28 — “Era tumanyi nga eri abo abaagala Katonda, era abo abayitibwa ng’okuteesa kwe bwe kuli, ebintu byonna bibatuukako olw’obulungi.”

Essuula 6 — Corrie ten Boom

Abafiripi 4:6–7 — “Temweraliikiriranga kintu na kimu, wabula mu buli kintu mu kusabanga ne mu kwegayiriranga awamu n’okwebazanga, mutegeezenga Katonda bye mwetaaga. N’emirembe gya Katonda, egisukkiridde okutegeera kwammwe ginaabakuumanga amagezi gammwe n’emitima gyammwe mu Kristo Yesu.”

Zabbuli 23:4 — “Newaakubadde nga ntambulira mu kiwonvu eky’ekisiikirize eky’olumbe, siritya kabi konna; kubanga ggwe oli nange. Oluga lwo n’omuggo gwo bye binsanyusa.”

1 Peetero 5:7 — “Mumutwalirenga byonna bye mweraliikirira kubanga abalumirwa era afaayo ku buli ekibatuukako.”

Abaruumi 8:38–39 — “Kubanga nkakasiza ddala nga newaakubadde okufa, wadde obulamu, wadde bamalayika, wadde abafuzi, wadde ebiriwo, wadde ebigenda okujja, wadde amaanyi, wadde obugulumivu, wadde okukka wansi, wadde ekitonde ekirala kyonna, tewali kiriyinza kutwawukanya n’okwagala kwa Katonda okuli mu Kristo Yesu Mukama waffe.”

Isaaya 40:31 — “Naye abo abalindirira Mukama baliddamu buggya amaanyi gaabwe, balitumbiira n’ebiwaawaatiro ng’empungu; balidduka mbiro ne batakoowa, balitambula naye ne batazirika.”

Essuula 7 — Lottie Moon

Matayo 9:37–38 — “Eby’okukungula bingi nnyo, naye abakozi abakungula batono. Noolwekyo musabe nannyini nnimiro, aweereze abakozi mu nnimiro ye.”

Yokaana 12:24 — “Ddala ddala mbagamba nti empeke y’eŋŋaano bw’egwa mu ttaka efa, bwe tefa ebeera yokka, naye bw’efa ebala ebibala bingi.”

Abaruumi 1:16 — “Enjiri tenkwasa nsonyi: kubanga ge maanyi ga Katonda agalokola buli muntu akkiriza, okusooka eri Omuyudaaya n’eri Omunnamawanga.”

Abaruumi 10:14–15 — “Kale balikoowoola batya oyo gwe batakkiririzaamu? Era balikkiriza batya oyo gwe batawulirangako? Era baliwulira batya awatali abuulira? Era balibuulira batya nga tebatumiddwa?”

2 Abakkolinso 5:14 — “Kubanga okwagala kwa Katonda kutuwaliriza, ng’omu bwe yafiirira bonna, bonna kyebaava bafa.”

Essuula 8 — Mary Slessor

Yoswa 1:9 — “Totya era toterebuka kubanga Mukama Katonda wo anaabanga naawe buli gy’onoogendanga.”

Isaaya 6:8 — “Nze wendi! Tuma nze!”

Zekkaliya 4:6 — “Si lwa maanyi so si lwa buyinza naye lwa Mwoyo wange,” bw’ayogera Mukama ow’Eggye.

Matayo 4:16 — “Abantu abaatuulanga mu kizikiza, balabye Omusana mungi. Abaatuulanga mu nsi ey’ekisiikirize eky’okufa, omusana gubaakidde.”

Abaebbulaniya 11:33–34 — “Abaawangula bakabaka olw’okukkiriza, be baakola eby’obutuukirivu, be baafuna ebyasuubizibwa, era be baabuniza obumwa bw’empologoma, be baazikiza omuliro ogw’amaanyi, be baawona obwogi bw’ekitala. Be baaweebwa amaanyi okuva mu bunafu, era be baafuuka abazira ab’amaanyi mu ntalo.”

Essuula 9 — Gladys Aylward

Yeremiya 29:11 — “Kubanga mmanyi enteekateeka ze nnina gye muli,” bw’ayogera Mukama, “enteekateeka ez’okubakulaakulanya so si okubakolako akabi, enteekateeka ez’okubawa essuubi era n’obulamu obw’omu maaso.”

Zabbuli 121:1–2 — “Nnyimusa amaaso gange eri ensozi, okubeerwa kwange kuva wa? Okubeerwa kwange kuva eri Mukama, eyakola eggulu n’ensi.”

Makko 9:23 — “Buli kimu kisoboka eri oyo akkiriza.”

Engero 3:5–6 — “Weesige Mukama n’omutima gwo gwonna, so teweesigamanga ku magezi go gokka. Mukama mukulembezenga mu by’okola byonna, naye anaakuluŋŋamyanga n’owangula.”

2 Abakkolinso 5:7 — “Kubanga tutambula lwa kukkiriza so si lw’amaaso gaffe bye galaba.”

Essuula 10 — Evelyn Christenson

Yakobo 5:16 — “Okusaba n’omutima omumalirivu ogw’omuntu omutuukirivu, kubeera n’obuyinza bungi, era n’ebivaamu biba bya ttendo.”

Matayo 18:19–20 — “Era ddala ddala mbagamba nti bwe munaabanga babiri mu nsi ne mukkiriziganya ku ekyo kye mwagala okusaba, Kitange ali mu ggulu alikibakolera. Kubanga abantu ababiri oba abasatu bwe banaakuŋŋaananga mu linnya lyange, nange nnaabeeranga awo wakati waabwe.”

1 Yokaana 5:14–15 — “Noolwekyo tulina obuvumu nti bwe tugenda gy’ali ne tumusaba ekintu kyonna, ye nga bw’asiima atuwulira. Era bwe tutegeera nti atuwulira bwe tumusaba, buli kye tumusaba talema kukituwa.”

Abakkolosaayi 4:2 — “Munyiikirirenga mu kusaba, nga temuddirira, wabula nga mwebazanga.”

Ebikolwa by’Abatume 2:42 — “Ne banyiikiranga okuyigirizibwa kw’abatume ne mu kussekimu, ne mu kumenya omugaati era ne mu kusaba.”

“Mulinnoonya ne mundaba bwe mulinnoonya n’omutima gwammwe gwonna.”

— Yeremiya 29:13
fields.body_text: Ebyawandiikibwa bino ebikwata ku kusaba bijuliziddwa mu kitabo kino kyonna. Ennyiriri zonna wano ziggiddwa mu Bayibuli mu Luganda Olwa Leero. Ennyanjula Yoweeri 2:28–29 — “Batabani bammwe ne bawala bammwe balitegeeza eby’omu maaso; abakadde baliroota ebirooto, n’abavubuka bammwe balyolesebwa. Mu biro ebyo ndifuka Omwoyo wange ku baweereza bange abasajja n’abakazi.” Ebikolwa by’Abatume 16:13 — “Gye baali batutegeezezza nti waliwo abakuŋŋaanirayo okusabirayo. Ne tutuula wamu n’abakazi abaali bazze okusaba ne twogera nabo.” Yokaana 16:23–24 — “Mu kiseera ekyo nga temukyansaba kintu na kimu, mmwe bennyini munaasabanga Kitange mu linnya lyange. Kino mubadde temukikola, naye kaakano mukitandike. Musabe mu linnya lyange, mujja kuweebwa ekyo kye musaba, essanyu lyammwe liryoke lituukirire.” Abakkolosaayi 4:2 — “Munyiikirirenga mu kusaba, nga temuddirira, wabula nga mwebazanga.” Essuula 1 — Monika ow’e Hippo Lukka 18:1 — “Nga bwe bagwanidde obutakoowanga kusaba n’obutaggwaamu mwoyo.” Zabbuli 56:8 — “Emirundi gye ntawaanyizibwa nga njaziirana ogimanyi; amaziga gange gateeke mu ccupa yo! Wagawandiika.” 1 Timoseewo 2:1–4 — “Okusookera ddala, mbasaba, musabenga, mwegayirirenga, era mwebazenga Katonda ku lw’abantu bonna. Era musabirenga bakabaka n’abafuzi abalala bonna, tulyoke tube bulungi nga tuli mirembe, nga tussaamu Katonda ekitiibwa, era nga twegendereza mu buli ngeri. Ekyo kirungi era ekisiimibwa mu maaso ga Katonda Omulokozi waffe, ayagala abantu bonna balokolebwe, era bategeere amazima.” Okukungubaga 2:19 — “Golokoka, okaabe ekiro obudde nga bwa kaziba; Fuka emmeeme yo ng’amazzi mu maaso ga Mukama.” Zabbuli 126:5–6 — “Abo abasiga nga bakaaba amaziga, baliyimba ennyimba ez’essanyu nga bakungula. Oyo agenda ng’akaaba ng’atwala ensigo okusiga; alikomawo ng’ayimba ennyimba ez’essanyu ng’aleeta ebinywa bye.” Essuula 2 — Teresa ow’e Ávila Matayo 6:6 — “Naye ggwe bw’obanga osaba, oyingiranga mu nnyumba yo, ne weggalira mu kisenge kyo n’osabira eyo mu kyama. Kitaawo ategeera ebyama byo byonna alikuwa by’omusabye.” Zabbuli 46:10 — “Musiriikirire mutegeere nga nze Katonda.” 2 Abakkolinso 12:9 — “Buli mulundi ng’aŋŋamba nti, ‘Ekisa kyange kikumala, kubanga amaanyi gange gatuukirira mu bunafu.’ Noolwekyo kyennaavanga nneegulumiza n’essanyu lingi olw’obunafu bwange, amaanyi ga Kristo galyoke galabisibwe.” Yokaana 15:5 — “Kubanga awatali Nze temuliiko kye muyinza kukola.” Essuula 3 — Susanna Wesley Engero 22:6 — “Manyiiriza omwana mu kkubo erimugwanira okutambulirangamu, ne bw’alikula talirivaamu.” Zabbuli 119:147 — “Ngolokoka bunatera okukya ne nkukaabirira onnyambe; essuubi lyange liri mu kigambo kyo.” Yeremiya 29:11 — “Kubanga mmanyi enteekateeka ze nnina gye muli,” bw’ayogera Mukama, “enteekateeka ez’okubakulaakulanya so si okubakolako akabi, enteekateeka ez’okubawa essuubi era n’obulamu obw’omu maaso.” Matayo 18:20 — “Kubanga abantu ababiri oba abasatu bwe banaakuŋŋaananga mu linnya lyange, nange nnaabeeranga awo wakati waabwe.” Yoswa 24:15 — “Nze n’ennyumba yange, ffe tunaaweerezanga Mukama Katonda.” Essuula 4 — Madame Guyon Abafiripi 4:11–12 — “Mu buli mbeera gye mbaamu nayiga okumalibwanga. Mmanyi okubeera nga sirina kantu, era mmanyi okuba nga nnina buli kimu.” Yokaana 15:15 — “Olwo nga sikyabayita baddu, kubanga omuddu tamanya bifa ku mukama we. Kaakano mmwe muli mikwano gyange, kubanga mbategeezezza byonna Kitange bye yaŋŋamba.” Isaaya 43:2 — “Bw’onooyitanga mu mazzi amawanvu nnaabeeranga naawe, ne bw’onooyitanga mu migga tegirikusaanyaawo; bw’onooyitanga mu muliro tegukwokyenga, ennimi z’omuliro tezirikwokya.” Abafiripi 4:7 — “N’emirembe gya Katonda, egisukkiridde okutegeera kwammwe ginaabakuumanga amagezi gammwe n’emitima gyammwe mu Kristo Yesu.” 2 Abakkolinso 3:17 — “Kale nno Mukama ye Mwoyo, era buli Omwoyo wa Mukama w’abeera, wabaawo eddembe.” Essuula 5 — Amy Carmichael Abaggalatiya 2:20 — “Nakomererwa wamu ne Kristo; kyokka ndi mulamu, si ku bwange, wabula ku bwa Kristo abeera mu nze; era obulamu bwe nnina kaakano mu mubiri, mbulina lwa kukkiriza Omwana wa Katonda, eyanjagala ne yeewaayo yekka ku lwange.” Lukka 10:2 — “Eby’okukungula bingi, naye abakozi abakungula batono. Noolwekyo musabe nannyini nnimiro, aweereze abakozi mu nnimiro ye.” Isaaya 41:10 — “Totya kubanga nze ndi wamu naawe; tokeŋŋentererwa, kubanga nze Katonda wo. Nnaakuwanga amaanyi. Wewaawo nnaakuyambanga n’omukono ogwa ddyo ogw’obutuukirivu bwange.” Lukka 9:23 — “Omuntu yenna ayagala okungoberera asaana yeefiirize yekka yeetikke omusaalaba gwe buli lunaku, angoberere!” Abaruumi 8:28 — “Era tumanyi nga eri abo abaagala Katonda, era abo abayitibwa ng’okuteesa kwe bwe kuli, ebintu byonna bibatuukako olw’obulungi.” Essuula 6 — Corrie ten Boom Abafiripi 4:6–7 — “Temweraliikiriranga kintu na kimu, wabula mu buli kintu mu kusabanga ne mu kwegayiriranga awamu n’okwebazanga, mutegeezenga Katonda bye mwetaaga. N’emirembe gya Katonda, egisukkiridde okutegeera kwammwe ginaabakuumanga amagezi gammwe n’emitima gyammwe mu Kristo Yesu.” Zabbuli 23:4 — “Newaakubadde nga ntambulira mu kiwonvu eky’ekisiikirize eky’olumbe, siritya kabi konna; kubanga ggwe oli nange. Oluga lwo n’omuggo gwo bye binsanyusa.” 1 Peetero 5:7 — “Mumutwalirenga byonna bye mweraliikirira kubanga abalumirwa era afaayo ku buli ekibatuukako.” Abaruumi 8:38–39 — “Kubanga nkakasiza ddala nga newaakubadde okufa, wadde obulamu, wadde bamalayika, wadde abafuzi, wadde ebiriwo, wadde ebigenda okujja, wadde amaanyi, wadde obugulumivu, wadde okukka wansi, wadde ekitonde ekirala kyonna, tewali kiriyinza kutwawukanya n’okwagala kwa Katonda okuli mu Kristo Yesu Mukama waffe.” Isaaya 40:31 — “Naye abo abalindirira Mukama baliddamu buggya amaanyi gaabwe, balitumbiira n’ebiwaawaatiro ng’empungu; balidduka mbiro ne batakoowa, balitambula naye ne batazirika.” Essuula 7 — Lottie Moon Matayo 9:37–38 — “Eby’okukungula bingi nnyo, naye abakozi abakungula batono. Noolwekyo musabe nannyini nnimiro, aweereze abakozi mu nnimiro ye.” Yokaana 12:24 — “Ddala ddala mbagamba nti empeke y’eŋŋaano bw’egwa mu ttaka efa, bwe tefa ebeera yokka, naye bw’efa ebala ebibala bingi.” Abaruumi 1:16 — “Enjiri tenkwasa nsonyi: kubanga ge maanyi ga Katonda agalokola buli muntu akkiriza, okusooka eri Omuyudaaya n’eri Omunnamawanga.” Abaruumi 10:14–15 — “Kale balikoowoola batya oyo gwe batakkiririzaamu? Era balikkiriza batya oyo gwe batawulirangako? Era baliwulira batya awatali abuulira? Era balibuulira batya nga tebatumiddwa?” 2 Abakkolinso 5:14 — “Kubanga okwagala kwa Katonda kutuwaliriza, ng’omu bwe yafiirira bonna, bonna kyebaava bafa.” Essuula 8 — Mary Slessor Yoswa 1:9 — “Totya era toterebuka kubanga Mukama Katonda wo anaabanga naawe buli gy’onoogendanga.” Isaaya 6:8 — “Nze wendi! Tuma nze!” Zekkaliya 4:6 — “Si lwa maanyi so si lwa buyinza naye lwa Mwoyo wange,” bw’ayogera Mukama ow’Eggye. Matayo 4:16 — “Abantu abaatuulanga mu kizikiza, balabye Omusana mungi. Abaatuulanga mu nsi ey’ekisiikirize eky’okufa, omusana gubaakidde.” Abaebbulaniya 11:33–34 — “Abaawangula bakabaka olw’okukkiriza, be baakola eby’obutuukirivu, be baafuna ebyasuubizibwa, era be baabuniza obumwa bw’empologoma, be baazikiza omuliro ogw’amaanyi, be baawona obwogi bw’ekitala. Be baaweebwa amaanyi okuva mu bunafu, era be baafuuka abazira ab’amaanyi mu ntalo.” Essuula 9 — Gladys Aylward Yeremiya 29:11 — “Kubanga mmanyi enteekateeka ze nnina gye muli,” bw’ayogera Mukama, “enteekateeka ez’okubakulaakulanya so si okubakolako akabi, enteekateeka ez’okubawa essuubi era n’obulamu obw’omu maaso.” Zabbuli 121:1–2 — “Nnyimusa amaaso gange eri ensozi, okubeerwa kwange kuva wa? Okubeerwa kwange kuva eri Mukama, eyakola eggulu n’ensi.” Makko 9:23 — “Buli kimu kisoboka eri oyo akkiriza.” Engero 3:5–6 — “Weesige Mukama n’omutima gwo gwonna, so teweesigamanga ku magezi go gokka. Mukama mukulembezenga mu by’okola byonna, naye anaakuluŋŋamyanga n’owangula.” 2 Abakkolinso 5:7 — “Kubanga tutambula lwa kukkiriza so si lw’amaaso gaffe bye galaba.” Essuula 10 — Evelyn Christenson Yakobo 5:16 — “Okusaba n’omutima omumalirivu ogw’omuntu omutuukirivu, kubeera n’obuyinza bungi, era n’ebivaamu biba bya ttendo.” Matayo 18:19–20 — “Era ddala ddala mbagamba nti bwe munaabanga babiri mu nsi ne mukkiriziganya ku ekyo kye mwagala okusaba, Kitange ali mu ggulu alikibakolera. Kubanga abantu ababiri oba abasatu bwe banaakuŋŋaananga mu linnya lyange, nange nnaabeeranga awo wakati waabwe.” 1 Yokaana 5:14–15 — “Noolwekyo tulina obuvumu nti bwe tugenda gy’ali ne tumusaba ekintu kyonna, ye nga bw’asiima atuwulira. Era bwe tutegeera nti atuwulira bwe tumusaba, buli kye tumusaba talema kukituwa.” Abakkolosaayi 4:2 — “Munyiikirirenga mu kusaba, nga temuddirira, wabula nga mwebazanga.” Ebikolwa by’Abatume 2:42 — “Ne banyiikiranga okuyigirizibwa kw’abatume ne mu kussekimu, ne mu kumenya omugaati era ne mu kusaba.” “Mulinnoonya ne mundaba bwe mulinnoonya n’omutima gwammwe gwonna.” — Yeremiya 29:13
